JOB OVERVIEW:

The Equipment Coordination Specialist will be responsible for managing the post-order procurement process for dental equipment and supplies and ensuring the team is tracking toward the quarterly/annual Risk and Opportunity (RO) targets. This role supports the respective district(s) by ensuring installations are coordinated internally and externally in accordance with our policies and procedures to facilitate the timely delivery and installation of dental equipment.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manages the entire district installation process by working with the District Managers and Sales Representatives to determine appropriate installation dates and ensure all projects are current and on track with quarterly/annual RO. Leads the coordination of any installation date changes that may occur during the planning process.
  • Ensures all preparation is completed prior to the start of weekly Equipment Planning Meetings (EPMs), including scheduling customers; inputting current estimated shipping details and notes into internal software systems; daily/weekly adjustment of projected installation dates; manages the solutioning of credit issues; validates ‘Order Terms’ compliance prior to installation; and works directly with 3PL (or respective Henry Schein facilities) to ensure equipment is staged for delivery.
  • In conjunction with the District Manager, prepares for and leads all EPM for respective assigned district(s) to ensure equipment racking/anticipated arrivals and customer scheduling are transparent and seamless throughout the last-mile portion of the installation process.
  • Completes daily invoicing per order terms upon delivery/installation of equipment, including ensuring all credit and financial approvals are in place, and handles escalations as required.

Proactively vets the entire approval process based on the value and age of the equipment by ensuring all approval levels have been obtained. raw.title: Commercial Property Manager - Remote
raw.excerpt: ROLE TITLECommercial Property Manager We are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.
raw.description:
ROLE TITLE

Commercial Property Manager

We are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.

  • This is a fully remote Commercial Property Manager position.
  • Applications with an introduction video attached will be prioritized.
  • Due to the fully remote nature of this role, it is important that candidates are comfortable communicating on video calls.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Commercial Property Manager supports the day-to-day operations of a commercial property in Indianapolis, keeping leasing, tenant requests, maintenance, property information, and documentation moving without constant supervision.

You will manage multiple active workflows at once, including prospective tenant and application activity, lease paperwork, move-ins and move-outs, maintenance requests, vacancy updates, floor plan changes, tenant concerns, events, and property documents. The role requires consistent follow-through: identifying what needs to happen next, gathering missing information, coordinating with tenants, vendors, architects, and the property team, and tracking each item through completion.

This is an execution-heavy role for someone who can work independently, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions about when to act, when to follow up, and when to escalate. You should not need a daily task list to stay productive or wait for someone else to tell you the next step.

If you are strongest in narrowly defined administrative tasks and require frequent direction to move work forward, this role is not a fit.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Property Marketing and Vacancy Updates

• Keep commercial vacancies current on LoopNet MLS, including unit status, availability, renovations, and other relevant property information.

• Coordinate with the current architect when floor plans need to be updated because of changes to the property or individual units.

• Maintain accurate unit information across property marketing materials and internal records so vacancy information does not become outdated.

• Eventually take ownership of updating floor plans using AutoCAD or another floor plan editing tool.

Leasing Support

• Support the screening of new rental applications by gathering, organizing, and reviewing the required information before moving the application to the next step.

• Communicate with prospective tenants and applicants throughout the leasing process and respond to questions or missing information promptly.

• Assist with preparing lease documents and associated paperwork, ensuring required information is complete and organized.

• Coordinate lease signings and follow up on outstanding documentation rather than allowing paperwork to stall.

• Coordinate move-in and move-out processes and ensure the necessary information, documents, and follow-ups are completed.

• Support lease renewal activity by tracking upcoming renewals and coordinating the required next steps.

Maintenance and Work Order Management

• When a tenant reports a maintenance issue, gather enough information to understand what is happening, determine the appropriate next step, and avoid sending incomplete information to Jennifer or a vendor.

• Coordinate with internal team and vendors when repairs or maintenance are required.

• Track open maintenance requests through completion and follow up when a vendor response, update, or repair is delayed.

• Keep work order information current so the team can see what has been reported, who is handling it, what action is pending, and whether the issue has been resolved.

• Escalate issues when the available information is insufficient, the situation requires a decision outside your authority, or progress has stalled.

Document Control

• Develop and maintain standardized formats for forms and documents used across the organization.

• Apply consistent document layouts, fonts, formatting, and other readability standards rather than creating documents with inconsistent presentation.

• Keep documents organized and accessible so the correct version can be located without unnecessary back-and-forth.

• Manage multiple documents simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

Tenant Concierge

• Respond to tenant and guest requests involving common areas, events, Wi-Fi access, and building access.

• Determine what information or action is required for each request and coordinate with the appropriate person or vendor when the request cannot be resolved directly.

• Plan, organize, and coordinate building events, including vendor coordination and space setup.

• Ensure events and tenant activities follow applicable building rules and requirements.

Requirements

(NON-NEGOTIABLE)

• Proven work experience in property management, with the ability to handle actual property-management workflows rather than only general administrative support.

• Strong written and verbal English communication. You will communicate with tenants, applicants, vendors, architects, and internal stakeholders, so unclear or incomplete communication creates operational problems.

• Excellent proficiency in AppFolio or other property-management operational systems.

• Ability to manage multiple active property-management tasks and documents at the same time without losing track of follow-ups.

• Strong problem-solving ability. When a tenant reports an issue, you must be able to gather the relevant facts, identify the next action, and escalate appropriately instead of simply forwarding the complaint.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly when maintaining vacancy information, lease documentation, work orders, tenant records, and standardized documents.

• Ability to work independently in a remote, async environment and make routine execution decisions without requiring constant supervision.

• Ability to communicate early when an issue is blocked, information is missing, or a decision needs to be made by someone else.

• Comfort working across leasing, maintenance, tenant support, marketing, and document-management tasks rather than operating within a single narrow workflow.

TOOLS

• AppFolio

• LoopNet MLS

• Google Suite

• Slack
• Dropbox
• DocuSign
• AutoCAD or another floor plan editing software

WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

• You close loops. When a tenant, applicant, vendor, or internal stakeholder needs something, you track the request through the next required action instead of assuming someone else will follow up.

• You can work from incomplete information. You know what questions to ask, what information is missing, and when an issue needs escalation.

• You protect accuracy. Vacancy information, lease documents, work orders, floor plans, and property records need to stay current because other people act on that information.

• You can switch between priorities without dropping details. Leasing activity, maintenance requests, tenant questions, and document work may be active simultaneously.

• You communicate operationally. Updates should make it clear what happened, what is pending, who owns the next action, and when follow-up is required.

• You take ownership of recurring processes. Once a workflow is understood, you should be able to execute it consistently without requiring the same instructions repeatedly.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

• This is not a passive administrative VA role where you wait for someone to assign every next step.

• This is not a customer-service-only position. Tenant communication must be connected to actual property-management follow-through.

• This is not a pure leasing or sales position. The role also covers maintenance coordination, document control, property marketing, and tenant/building support.

• This is not a role where maintenance complaints are simply forwarded to the property manager or vendor without gathering information and tracking the issue.

• This is not a role for someone who is uncomfortable managing several open requests and documents at the same time.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Work Hours: US-aligned work hours
  • Work Style: Performance-driven, async environment with an expectation of independent execution
  • Engagement Structure: Virtual/remote staffing engagement; specific engagement terms are provided during the hiring process

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To apply, submit your resume and a short introduction explaining your commercial property-management experience.

Your application must also answer this scenario:

A tenant reports that their office has lost Wi-Fi access and says they have an important client meeting in one hour. They also mention that the building access door is intermittently failing. You have no immediate confirmation that either issue is affecting other tenants.

In 5–8 sentences, explain:

  1. What information you would gather first.
  2. Who you would contact or coordinate with.
  3. How you would prioritize the two issues.
  4. How you would track and communicate the status until resolution.

We are specifically looking for evidence of how you think through an active property-management issue, not a generic statement about being organized or proactive.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health Maintenance Organization (HMO)
  • Fully Remote Work

Our diverse team is comprised of highly motivated professionals with a passion for solving big problems with technology. raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

Support Data Center capacity planning across CrowdStrike's global data center footprint. You'll assign and track power, space, cooling, rack, and fiber port capacity; maintain forecasting models and dashboards; and partner with Data Center Operations, Network Engineering, Supply Chain, and Systems Infrastructure teams to ensure capacity is available ahead of demand.


What You'll Do:

  • Assign power, space, and rack capacity to incoming deployment requests; maintain allocation and reservation records
  • Maintain and update capacity models for power, space, cooling, cabinet, and structured cabling/port availability across all sites
  • Track fiber port capacity, utilization, and projected consumption across MDF and IDF locations — available vs. in-use patch panel ports, by site, by room, and by panel
  • Track vendor and carrier cross-connect port usage across PoP and DC facilities, including quantity in service, media/connector type, and growth against contracted or available positions
  • Submit expansion demand to DC Build ahead of fiber port or cross-connect exhaustion
  • Produce recurring capacity reporting and dashboards; surface constraint and threshold-breach risks to the DC Management
  • Translate server/storage/network demand forecasts into rack-level deployment plans and site allocation recommendations
  • Partner with Deployment Engineering and DC Ops on rack elevations, placement, and burn-down of installed vs. reserved capacity
  • Maintain data accuracy in DCIM/asset systems; drive reconciliation between DCIM, AssetDB, and physical audits
  • Support colo expansion and site build inputs: requirements gathering, capacity validation, and tracking of contracted vs. consumed power
  • Contribute to automation of reporting and data collection.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

What You'll Need:

  • US Citizen or Green Card Holder
  • 2–5 years in data center capacity planning, DC operations, infrastructure engineering, or related
  • Working knowledge of DC power distribution (UPS, RPP PDU, branch circuits, A/B feeds, redundancy models N+1/2N), cooling, and rack/space planning
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets modeling
  • Experience with a DCIM platform (Nlyte, Sunbird, Device42, or similar) and BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI, Grafana)
  • Ability to interpret rack elevations, one-lines, and floor plans

Bonus Points:

  • Hyperscale or large colo environment experience; multi-region footprint
  • Familiarity with network capacity concepts (port/fabric/uplink utilization)
  • Experience tracking cross-connect inventory in a DCIM or IPAM system

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

raw.description:
We are looking for a Solar Project Coordinator to support Project Managers and operations leadership in delivering solar projects. You will keep project documents organized, track contractual obligations and key dates, and manage project workspaces and reporting.

This role works closely with customers, contractors, engineers and vendors. It requires strong organization, timely follow-up and attention to detail. All project decisions and external communications are approved by the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor contractual obligations for project contracts with customers, contractors and vendors, with Project Manager direction
  • Enter approved contractual obligations into Smartsheet
  • Identify drop dead dates for project phases once contracts are executed, for Project Manager approval, and monitor them
  • Alert the Project Manager early to anticipated issues and contract amendments
  • Notify the Project Manager when change orders need to be initiated
  • Set up and onboard project workspace sheets in Smartsheet from templates, with active links, current data and properly managed tasks
  • File project documents daily in the correct Box folders, following the Box handbook and naming convention
  • Keep documents current, using the most recent version and the document date in file names
  • Suggest improvements to Box folder structure to the Project Manager and VP of Operations
  • Negotiate quotes and estimates with vendors and contractors
  • Upload quotes to Box and the budget sheet, linking them to the relevant rows
  • Prepare purchase orders for Project Manager approval, obtain PO numbers from the master tracking sheet, and send executed POs with the Controller copied
  • Prepare interconnection applications from the SLD/layout for Project Manager review, then submit them with documentation and upload to Box
  • Use the SolarEdge designer tool to map and publish system layouts for Project Manager review
  • Upload incoming invoices to Box and forward them to the Controller and Project Manager
  • Follow up weekly with contractors and develop weekly customer progress reports
  • Prepare weekly look-ahead reports for each project
  • Schedule weekly status meetings with the Project Manager
  • Schedule meetings with clients, contractors and engineers as directed by the Project Manager
  • Prepare meeting agendas and distribute meeting notes by email and Google Spaces
  • Notify the Controller when a project begins
  • Gather and draft the project closeout book for Project Manager review and approval
  • Respond to tasks promptly and explain any delayed deadlines in Smartsheet comments
  • Comply with company policies and procedures and maintain regular, predictable attendance

Requirements

  • Ability to manage project contracts and extract contractual obligations
  • Experience with Smartsheet or similar project tracking tools (specific experience level not stated)
  • Experience with Box or similar document management, including following file naming conventions
  • Ability to prepare purchase orders, progress reports and look-ahead reports
  • Ability to negotiate quotes and estimates with vendors and contractors
  • Strong organization, attention to detail and timely follow-up
  • Clear written communication for emails, meeting notes and reports
  • Ability to work under Project Manager direction and obtain approvals before external decisions
  • Familiarity with SolarEdge designer tool (preferred)
  • Experience preparing interconnection applications (preferred)
  • Regular and predictable attendance

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Associate – Risk Advisory to join our Financial Services Group (FSG). Our team serves a diverse portfolio of financial institutions and provides independent, risk-based assurance and advisory services across a wide range of banking operations. The Senior Associate is responsible for supervising, motivating, developing, and reviewing the work of Associates. This role offers an excellent opportunity to advance a career in internal audit while gaining exposure to key operational, financial, and risk management functions within financial institutions.

Consulting professionals at Accenture belong to one of three workgroups: Management Consulting, Systems Integration Consulting or Technology Consulting. These workgroups enable us to deliver the increasingly specialized skills that clients demand while providing our people with varied career opportunities.

Our management consultants have the opportunity to work and collaborate with colleagues from across the full spectrum of consulting activity: identifying and creatively solving complex problems, designing and re-engineering critical processes, and fundamentally transforming the way a company operates. Our management consultants are more than just theorists - they turn theory into action. Acting as trusted advisors to our clients, they work directly with FORTUNE© Global 500 companies across many different industry sectors. They concentrate on getting a holistic view of a client's business and industry environment and use their expertise and critical thinking skills to design and deliver realistic, achievable business strategies and solutions that address key client priorities.

Much of the work we do is at the cutting edge of innovation and thinking. We involve our consultants in publishing and sharing this knowledge as thought leadership to benefit clients, industry and fellow colleagues.

You are:

As a Patient Access & Experience Manager in our Health Provider business, you lead and support patient access and experience transformations for complex provider organizations such as national and regional health systems, academic medical centers, IDNs, and large medical groups. You bring deep expertise in access transformation, including scheduling optimization, workflow and throughput efficiencies, digital patient experience and self-service, and contact center performance, along with working knowledge of the broader patient journey. You know how to take an engagement from assessment through implementation, and you hold yourself accountable for results.

You build relationships with operational, clinical and digital leaders across areas impacting patient access and experience, and you know how to communicate findings in a way that leads to action. You’re comfortable managing up and managing across, keeping clients aligned, teams moving, and workstreams on track. You understand that good transformation work isn’t just about recommendations; it’s about bringing people along with you.

You stay current on how AI and automation are reshaping patient access and experience, from advanced capabilities in scheduling and virtual agents to digital self-service and personalized outreach, and you help clients translate those advances into practical, scalable improvements. You also know how to develop people, and you take that part of the job seriously.

The work:

Shape and Deliver Business Transformation Projects

  • Lead end-to-end patient access and experience engagements for complex, large-scale health care providers, with deep expertise across scheduling workflow and template optimization, referral and intake management, registration, contact center operations, digital front door, and patient communications and engagement
  • Reimagine and redesign access operating models. Lead workflow redesign, policy and procedure development, organizational and workforce realignment, and the design of KPIs and performance governance frameworks tied to appointment conversion and utilization, no-show and leakage reduction, call abandonment, digital engagement, and patient satisfaction
  • Identify and prioritize client value creation opportunities based on rigorous analysis, developing business cases and value propositions, benchmarking, and a clear-eyed view of performance gaps and strategic priorities
  • Develop implementation plans and lead cross-functional teams to deliver project outcomes on schedule, within budget, and against defined performance targets. Direct business pilots and client deployment activities and ensure planned outcomes are achieved and sustained after go-live
  • Embed AI, automation, and advanced analytics into patient access and experience operations to drive measurable improvement, applying advanced capabilities to analyze capacity and demand, model scheduling scenarios, and target use cases such as virtual agents, intelligent scheduling, digital deflection and self-service, personalized outreach, and agent assistance for contact centers
  • Advise clients on digital front door strategy, consumer engagement, and omnichannel access to address provider capacity constraints and meet rising patient expectations
  • Support technology enablement across provider IT, EHRs, and patient engagement platforms (e.g., CRM, contact center, scheduling and self-service tools), advising on business requirements, system optimization, interoperability, and workflow configuration aligned to access and experience objectives
  • Design and execute the engagement’s overall communication and change management approach, tailored to the client’s organizational culture and readiness.
  • Manage engagement risk, project economics, deliverable quality, and client satisfaction throughout the engagement lifecycle

Client Relationship Development and Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders, typically including VP and director level leaders across access and ambulatory operations, digital / IT and consumer engagement. Engage periodically with physicians and steering committee-level stakeholders.
  • Facilitate complex meetings, executive presentations, and cross-functional workshops that build client commitment, resolve competing priorities, and move transformation forward.
  • Cultivate follow-on opportunities and develop business cases and proposals that connect Accenture’s capabilities to client priorities, while managing engagement economics including budgets, revenue forecasting, and margin performance

Practice Building

  • Contribute to practice-building activities including conference participation, thought leadership development, market offering design, and recruiting
  • Develop and share recognized expertise in specific patient access and experience domains, such as access transformation, digital engagement, or contact center modernization, contributing to internal methodology, toolkits, and knowledge assets that strengthen Accenture’s market position
  • Coach and mentor consultants and analysts, setting high standards for analytical rigor and client communication while actively supporting their professional development and career growth
  • Stay current on the regulations, consumer trends, and technology shaping patient access and experience across hospitals, health systems, medical groups, and ambulatory settings

• Travel as needed, up to 80%

Here’s What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading patient access and experience transformation-related initiatives, across both business and technical aspects, including program planning and management, process design and optimization, experience working through organizational change, and excellent communication and presentation abilities
  • Minimum 3 years of consulting / advisory experience with healthcare provider and/or payer clients
  • Minimum 3 years experience in healthcare provider operations and customer experience capabilities – including patient access, patient experience, contact center, digital engagement, and/or CRM

Bonus points if:

  • Experience in ambulatory / clinic operations and/or physician enterprise environments, including practice operations and workflows, organizational design, and/or financial modeling
  • Working knowledge of EHR platforms and capabilities; in particular, Epic functional knowledge of patient access and engagement, self-service and outreach modules / capabilities
  • Working knowledge of contact center solutions (e.g. CCaaS, WFM, QM), CRM solutions (e.g. Salesforce, MS Dynamics), and/or patient engagement digital solutions (e.g. web / portal, AI / digital assistant)
  • Experience advising on or deploying AI, automation, and RPA in patient access / engagement context, such as contact center agent assist, conversational AI, etc.
  • MBA, MHA, or equivalent advanced degree

Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer (individual contributor) to join our Voice Platform team as a hands-on senior engineer for high-performance, network-facing services that power real-time voice communications for Genesys Cloud contact centers worldwide. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer who is strong in Java, AI and cloud backend development, proficient (or eager to grow) in C and systems-level software, skilled in networking and Linux, and motivated to deepen expertise in SIP/VoIP and voice-platform systems.

This is a deep technical role, not a people-management role. You will spend your time designing and building, work across cloud backend microservices, serverless components, and systems-level software, and raise the technical bar through hands-on contribution. Prior SIP/VoIP or contact-center experience is a plus, not a strict requirement. If you enjoy complex distributed systems, production ownership, and solving hard problems while continuing to learn a specialized domain, this is a high-impact opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

The primary responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to):

  • Design, develop, and deliver scalable cloud backend and voice-platform services that support real-time communications with high reliability and operational excellence.
  • Hands-on implement backend microservices in Java and Spring Boot, along with Python-based serverless functions (AWS Lambda) for event-driven and automation workloads.
  • building AI bots, agents using latest tech stack like MCP, RAG, vector database, guardrails, langchain framework.
  • Develop and maintain systems software in C, including work with network-facing and open-source platform components (e.g. OpenSIPS/SIP routing) used in real-time communications.
  • Contribute to full-stack features, including React-based UIs and operational tooling, where needed.
  • Build and operate services on AWS, ensuring scalable, observable, and production-ready solutions.
  • Apply strong networking and Linux systems skills to develop, integrate, and troubleshoot real-time communications workloads.
  • Apply deep understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and thread-safety to design and troubleshoot high-throughput, low-latency services.
  • Build fluency in SIP/VoIP and Genesys voice-platform concepts and apply them effectively in your work.
  • Own troubleshooting of complex production issues spanning networking, systems, and service layers; drive root-cause analysis and lasting fixes using observability tooling such as SumoLogic and New Relic.
  • Drive strong system design: translate ambiguous requirements into clear architecture, make sound trade-offs, and document decisions for scalability, fault tolerance, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, DevOps, QA, security, and operations to translate business and platform needs into durable technical solutions.
  • Champion engineering best practices for design, code quality, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, logging, tracing, and production operations.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on collaboration (individual contributor; no direct reports).
  • Drive continuous improvement in system performance, availability, scalability, fault tolerance, and maintainability across the voice platform.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience as a hands-on individual contributor, including staff/principal-level technical impact.
  • Proven ability to drive technical initiatives from architecture through production delivery.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and influence engineering direction without formal authority.
  • Strong communication skills across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical, high-availability production systems.
  • Strong system design and analytical/problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn SIP/VoIP and real-time communications concepts quickly.
  • Ability to balance quality, performance, security, and delivery timelines.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Proficient with AI coding assistants and agentic dev tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, Claude, ChatGPT) across the SDLC — design exploration, code generation, test and documentation generation, large-scale refactoring, log and incident analysis. Strong judgment on when to trust, verify, or reject AI output, with attention to correctness, security, licensing, and data-privacy.
  • In depth knowledge of SIP, VoIP, RTP/SRTP.

Must Have (Core Technical Skills)

  • Languages:Java (strong), Python, C (systems/network-oriented software, or proven ability to ramp quickly).
  • Framework:Spring Boot, Spring; REST API design.
  • Experience building AI-powered features or internal tooling: integrating LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock), MCP servers/agents, RAG pipelines, embeddings, or vector databases. Experience applying AI/LLMs to observability and operations (e.g. automated log analysis, incident summarization, runbook generation). Awareness of AI safety, prompt-injection risks, and secure handling of code and data with third-party AI tools.
  • Architecture: Microservices and distributed systems design and operation.
  • Concurrency: Deep understanding of multithreading, thread lifecycle, synchronization, and thread-safety.
  • AWS: Hands-on building and operating services on AWS — EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS/PostgreSQL, S3, SNS/SQS, ElastiCache (Redis), IAM, CloudWatch.
  • Networking: Strong fundamentals — TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, TLS/mTLS, sockets, HTTP, and network debugging.
  • OS: Strong Linux experience in development and production environments.
  • Observability: Production issue analysis and root-cause using SumoLogic and New Relic.
  • CI/CD: Pipeline-as-code, automated testing and deployment (e.g. Jenkins).

Nice to Have (Bonus)

  • Voice/Telecom: open-source telecom platforms (OpenSIPS, Kamailio, Asterisk, FreeSWITCH).
  • Domain: Genesys Cloud CX, contact-center, carrier, CCaaS, UCaaS, or CPaaS experience.
  • Front-end: React for operational and customer-facing tooling.
  • AWS (extended): ECS/EKS, API Gateway, VPC/PrivateLink, Route 53, Secrets Manager, KMS.
  • IaC: Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Serverless Framework, Ansible.
  • Messaging/Streaming: Kafka/MSK or equivalent.
  • Networking/Security: TLS 1.3, SRTP, network segmentation, service mesh (e.g. Envoy), multi-region deployments, Kubernetes.

Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
  • A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
  • Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team.
  • We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases.
  • After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.


Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.

Get notified about relevant opportunities.


Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.


Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.


About Genesys:

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.

You can expect a response within 24–48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email.

This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation—such as application follow-ups or resume submissions—may not receive a response.

raw.description:
Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business agility, and long-term competitiveness across the insurance and investment businesses.

The role involves developing and executing the organization's transformation strategy, modernizing business models, optimizing operating structures, driving digital adoption, and leading strategic change programs. The CTO will work closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team to translate corporate strategy into measurable transformation outcomes.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, financial and operational expertise, technology awareness, and strong change management capabilities, with a proven track record of delivering complex transformation initiatives in insurance, investment management, banking, or financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, profitability, and organizational agility.
  • Align transformation priorities with corporate strategy, market conditions, and long-term business objectives.
  • Evaluate existing business models, organizational structures, and operating processes to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Establish transformation objectives, milestones, governance frameworks, and measurable success criteria.

Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead initiatives to modernize business models, operating structures, and service delivery frameworks.
  • Drive organizational restructuring, process redesign, and business integration initiatives.
  • Improve operational efficiency across insurance underwriting, claims, policy administration, distribution, and customer service.
  • Support transformation of investment operations, portfolio reporting, client servicing, and wealth management processes, where applicable.
  • Develop scalable operating models to support business expansion, diversification, and organizational growth.

Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead technology-enabled business transformation initiatives in collaboration with the CIO, CTO, and CDO.
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI, advanced analytics, cloud solutions, and digital platforms.
  • Modernize legacy systems, enterprise applications, and operational infrastructure.
  • Oversee transformation programs involving InsurTech, FinTech, digital insurance, and investment platforms.
  • Ensure technology investments deliver measurable improvements in productivity, customer experience, and business performance.

Financial & Operational Performance Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Lead cost transformation, process efficiency, and productivity improvement programs.
  • Establish performance management frameworks and operational KPIs.
  • Evaluate transformation business cases, financial benefits, investment requirements, and expected returns.
  • Monitor cost savings, revenue improvements, and overall financial impact of transformation initiatives.

Organizational Change Management

  • Develop and implement change management strategies to support enterprise transformation.
  • Build organizational readiness and secure leadership and employee engagement.
  • Lead communication, training, and stakeholder engagement initiatives during transformation programs.
  • Address resistance to change and promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Support leadership development and workforce transformation initiatives.

Customer & Business Experience Transformation

  • Drive initiatives to improve customer journeys and service delivery across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer and commercial leadership to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and engagement.
  • Simplify customer onboarding, claims processing, policy renewals, investment transactions, and client servicing.
  • Promote customer-centric operating models and consistent service standards.
  • Use customer insights and analytics to identify transformation priorities.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Work with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen organizational controls.
  • Lead initiatives to improve regulatory reporting, risk management processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Assess transformation-related operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Establish appropriate controls and accountability throughout transformation programs.

Strategic Projects, M&A & Business Integration

  • Oversee major strategic transformation programs, including mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration.
  • Lead integration of business processes, systems, teams, and organizational structures following acquisitions.
  • Support new market entry, geographic expansion, and business diversification initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional transformation projects involving multiple subsidiaries and business units.
  • Track project outcomes and ensure delivery of expected strategic and financial benefits.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with the CEO, Board, executive team, and business unit heads to establish transformation priorities.
  • Lead transformation offices, program directors, project managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Establish transformation governance, reporting structures, and performance accountability.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology partners, and implementation specialists.
  • Present transformation progress, business impact, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Business Strategy, Organizational Development, Finance, or Transformation Management preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, operational excellence, or enterprise change management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership role overseeing large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Significant experience in insurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading complex enterprise transformation programs with measurable financial and operational outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience in operating model redesign, organizational restructuring, digital transformation, and process optimization.
  • Strong financial acumen, strategic planning, and business performance management capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder engagement, and change management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Prosci Change Management Certification.
  • Certified Business Transformation Professional (CBTP).
  • PMP or Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation milestones.
  • Cost savings and operational efficiency improvements.
  • Revenue growth and profitability improvements resulting from transformation.
  • Reduction in process turnaround times and operational bottlenecks.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.

- Digital adoption and automation rates.

  • Customer satisfaction and service delivery improvements.
  • Employee engagement and organizational change adoption.
  • Successful integration of acquired businesses and strategic partnerships.
  • Realization of expected transformation benefits and ROI.
  • Regulatory compliance and risk management effectiveness.
  • Delivery of transformation initiatives within approved budgets and timelines.

Join an award-winning and talented organization that delivers world-class healthcare workforce solutions. We are seeking a Manager of Internal Talent Acquisition to provide leadership and guidance to our TA team and steer the internal hiring for the organization.

The ideal candidate will have experience in hiring for internal positions as well as leading a team of TA personnel responsible for hiring for GTM and Corporate internal positions, ranging from Administrative roles to high-level (VP, BD, or Sales Directors, etc.) based in the United States, Costa Rica, Philippines, and Canada

● Develop and execute recruiting strategies across the organization and for all departments & positions

raw.excerpt: TLDR: You would help the world's most important technology and AI companies execute their most critical transformations.
raw.description:
TLDR: You would help the world's most important technology and AI companies execute their most critical transformations. You will be joining a team where you can build a career as a true industry leader and drive lasting, measurable impact on the market every day.

We Are:

Technology companies - Software, AI, advertising platforms, and hyperscalers are rewriting every industry and we help the companies doing the rewriting turn their strategy into results. We are the industry consultants and advisors for the world's most consequential technology companies: hyperscalers building the infrastructure that powers the global economy, software platforms reinventing how they grow and compete, and AI-native companies building an entirely new category.

Our clients need someone who can make everything they envision happen with speed and at scale. We work on the hardest execution challenges in tech industry today. How do you roll out a new AI-powered operating model across a 50,000-person organization? How do you stand up data center infrastructure fast enough to meet demand without blowing cost targets? How do you drive adoption of a new platform when the business keeps moving? Our work generally focuses on four domains:

  • Product & Go to Market | inclusive of building, launching, and scaling products; driving forward-deployed engagements to embed the customer in the product; managing enablement; executing go-to-market transformation and monetization initiatives at speed and scale

  • Platform Services | shifting platforms from manual operations to Data & AI-powered services; implementing the operating models and processes that maximize trust, growth, and efficiency at billion-user scale

  • AI Compute Capabilities | inclusive of helping companies build and operate AI infrastructure efficiently; executing data center delivery programs, driving utilization and ROI across the full lifecycle, and managing cost takeout opportunities across the business

  • Transformation + Value | inclusive of executing end-to-end reinvention across mega-processes; delivering the programs that make AI adoption real; measuring and capturing value across the enterprise; and orchestrating the industry focus around customer zero

You Are:

A consultant with real experience inside or alongside the tech industry and the operational instincts to match. You know how to take a strategy and make it work in practice. You understand the gap between a good plan and a plan that gets implemented, and you close it.

You are energized by complexity, comfortable in fast-moving environments, and skilled at getting organizations to move. You define and track market trends while helping your clients outpace them through disciplined execution and sustained operational change. You build trust with clients that lasts beyond a single engagement, hold yourself and your team to a high bar on delivery, and show up every day focused on driving clear, measurable impact.

The Work:

  • Translate strategies and roadmaps into action; building the implementation plans, workstreams, and operating models that make transformation real for technology companies.

  • Drive execution directly alongside client teams; removing barriers, managing stakeholders, and making sure initiatives land with lasting impact rather than sitting in a deck.

  • Size the value at stake for transformation initiatives and track delivery against it; helping clients understand and capture the ROI of the work in real time.

  • Execute on cost reduction and efficiency opportunities across client operations; including AI-related spend, infrastructure utilization, and process overhead.

  • Build the project infrastructure that keeps complex engagements running; workplans, governance structures, decision logs, and risk tracking.

  • Develop client-ready materials that communicate progress, decisions, and recommendations clearly to executive stakeholders.

  • Structure and lead workstreams from start to finish; designing the approach, managing the work, and delivering outputs that are ready for the client without a second pass.

  • Own quality across everything the team produces. Coherence, rigor, and client-readiness are the standard.

  • Support business development; contributing to proposals, shaping the point of view on new opportunities, and helping grow existing client relationships.

  • Lead the client relationship day-to-day; managing communication, setting expectations, and building trust over time.

  • Keep internal delivery on track; coordinating across workstreams and making sure the right people are focused on the right things.

  • Develop junior team members; give honest feedback, create real ownership opportunities, and invest in their growth.

  • Travel: Average 40–50% (up to 80% as needed).

Here's What You Need:

  • A bachelor's degree.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the tech industry or consulting.

Bonus Points If:

  • You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree.
  • Strong client communication skills with a proven ability to influence and inspire senior executives.
  • A proven track record of delivery on complex, high-impact client engagements where AI played a central role.
  • Hands-on experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or AI-powered platforms to solve real business problems.
  • Prior experience driving insights using visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx) and analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
  • Familiarity with AI development ecosystems, LLM-based tooling, or AI platform strategies is a strong plus.

raw.title: Deal Desk and Sales Operations Specialist
raw.excerpt: At TRG, we have been securing better lives for the last 9 years.
raw.description:
At TRG, we have been securing better lives for the last 9 years. TRG enables silo elimination and AI in one of the most complex operational sectors in the world of intelligence. Our platforms empower sovereign nations and government entities to combat crime and terror through AI-driven data fusion, analytics and intelligence capabilities. TRG deploys on-premise or air-gapped, is sovereign by design, and is operational within days.

About the role

You are the commercial backbone of our B2G sales teams and the owner of the deal process. Every proposal passes through you before final approval. You build quotes, check contracts and terms, and help sales managers move their deals forward across our three deal types: silo replacement, multi-silo stack consolidation, and project-based analytics displacement, including national-scale programs.

You also run the weekly numbers behind the pipeline, so that leadership and Finance can rely on them. Sales managers own their deals and their CRM records; you check them and follow up.

What you will do

Quotes and pricing

  • Build fast, repeatable quotes and proposals with the calculator and templates: silo swap-outs, multi-silo consolidation cases and multi-year structures for larger programs.
  • Prepare consolidation cases that compare a customer's existing contracts with a single TRG platform.
  • Handle multi-currency pricing, payment terms, and licensing, support and deployment structures; model partner and integrator margins.
  • Build proposal templates for the different use cases in the region.

Approvals and contracts

  • Give the first approval on every proposal: products, scope, price, payment terms and terms and conditions, checked against the price list, the calculator and company policy. Flag any discount or non-standard term for approval under the approval matrix. Finance, Legal and sales leadership give the final approval.
  • Maintain the approval matrix (discounts, payment terms, liability, non-standard terms) and a library of standard terms and approved fallback positions.
  • Review contracts, purchase commitments, partner and exclusivity terms with Legal, and flag anything non-standard.
  • Run end-user, channel, KYC, sanctions and export-control checks with Legal before a deal goes ahead.
  • Prepare the commercial and pricing side of tenders: price sheet, commercial inputs and deadlines, together with the sales manager.
  • Respond to every quote and approval request within 2 working hours, or within 2 hours of the start of the next business day if it arrives out of hours.

Deal process

  • Own the deal process from first request to signed deal. Track proposals that were sent but have no answer from the customer, remind the sales manager to follow up, and flag stuck deals to the sales manager and the head of department.
  • Check that deal records in the CRM (Asana for now) are complete: stage, value, close date and documents (proposal, end-user statement, purchase order). Return gaps to the sales manager, who owns and updates the record.

raw.description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled AI Scientist – Molecular Machine Learning to join our innovative and dynamic team.

AI Scientist – Molecular Machine Learning | About You

As an AI Scientist – Molecular Machine Learning, you will design and develop advanced AI/ML models that accelerate molecular property prediction, molecular generation, and drug discovery. You will apply deep learning, graph neural networks, geometric learning, transformers, and generative AI to complex molecular and chemical datasets, partnering closely with computational chemists and drug discovery scientists to solve high-impact scientific challenges. The ideal candidate is an AI/ML-first scientist with strong model development expertise and demonstrated experience applying machine learning to chemistry, molecular design, or drug discovery.

AI Scientist – Molecular Machine Learning | Day-to-Day

  • Design, develop, train, and evaluate deep learning models for molecular property prediction, molecular generation, and drug discovery applications.
  • Build molecular AI solutions using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Graph Transformers, geometric deep learning, and generative modeling techniques.
  • Develop scalable AI/ML workflows using Python, PyTorch and/or JAX, optimizing models for accuracy, efficiency, and scientific relevance.
  • Build and manage molecular datasets and cheminformatics workflows using RDKit and related tools, including molecular representation, preprocessing, feature generation, and model-ready dataset development.
  • Develop generative modeling approaches for de novo molecular design, lead optimization, and molecular exploration, leveraging techniques such as diffusion models, flow matching, reinforcement learning, or related architectures.
  • Collaborate with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and drug discovery scientists to translate scientific problems into AI/ML approaches and generate actionable insights for molecular discovery programs.
  • Evaluate and continuously improve molecular ML models using rigorous experimentation, validation, benchmarking, and reproducible research practices.

AI Scientist – Molecular Machine Learning | Skills & Experience

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Computational Chemistry, Cheminformatics, Data Science, Physics, or a related technical or scientific discipline, with relevant experience applying AI/ML to molecular or scientific problems.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with PyTorch and/or JAX, including developing, training, evaluating, and optimizing deep learning models.
  • Demonstrated experience with Graph Neural Networks, Graph Transformers, geometric deep learning, and generative AI, particularly for molecular representation, property prediction, or molecular design.
  • Strong Python programming and cheminformatics experience, including RDKit or comparable toolkits, with experience working with complex molecular datasets.
  • Experience applying AI/ML to molecular property prediction, molecular generation, drug discovery, ADMET modeling, lead optimization, or related molecular science applications.
  • Experience working within Linux and high-performance computing environments, with exposure to tools such as Schrödinger, MOE, GROMACS, OpenMM, or other molecular modeling platforms considered valuable.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Our University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting and cultivating the future leaders of this industry. This program offers paid positions for students and recent grads, designed to provide exposure to work that makes an impact while being supported through a structured experience with seasoned professionals. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven, graduates to join our 6-month Falcon Complete Graduate program. If you’re dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organisations against the most advanced attackers in the world, our CrowdStrike virtual security operations centre will provide you with opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of hands-on training and experiences. The program provides successful graduates with a structured learning path, mentoring by a dedicated Falcon Complete training lead and the opportunity to obtain industry recognised CrowdStrike certifications including the CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA) and CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR).


You will have access to a wide variety of learning material, tools and other resources to support your learning as well as exposure to working within customer environments. At the end of the 6-month Falcon Complete Graduate program you will be experienced with the administration of the CrowdStrike Falcon platform and have been exposed to how to respond, contain and remediate threats on customer endpoints.


The Falcon Complete Graduate program is a six-month contract with the potential for ongoing employment as a Falcon Complete Associate Analyst where your detection, investigation and analysis skills will be further developed.


Why the Falcon Complete Team?

  • Do you find yourself interested in putting your hands-on technical skills to the test in detecting, containing, and remediating incidents?
  • Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?
  • Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?
  • Are you looking to increase your Incident Response or Information Security skills?
  • Do you love working around like-minded, smart people who you can learn from on a daily basis?

What You'll Do:

  • Assist with triage of incoming issues to assess the priority, address the issue or escalate to appropriate internal teams.
  • Escalate alerts or customer queries that indicate a potential security incident to Falcon Complete analysts.
  • Implement changes to customer environments in a secure manner.
  • Produce high quality written and verbal communications to customers in response to questions or queries regarding the Falcon Platform or Falcon Complete Service.
  • Liaising with Falcon Complete analysts and Security Advisors to coordinate response and actions across any customers as required.
  • Liaising with Support teams to help troubleshoot and coordinate efforts to resolve technical issues.
  • Handle high pressure situations in a productive and professional manner.

What You'll Need:

  • 0-2 years of relevant incident handling skills.
  • Fundamental understanding of information security.
  • Fundamental understanding of sysinternals.
  • Fundamental understanding of network communications.
  • Desire to grow and expand technical and business skills.
  • Postgraduate students, recent graduates or current students graduating by 31 Jan 2027 in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Maths, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or related areas of study; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Nice to Have:

Experience in any of the following areas:

  • Incident Handling: experience conducting or managing incident response for organisations, investigating targeted threats such as the Advanced Persistent Threat, Organized Crime, and Hacktivists.
  • Computer Forensic Analysis: a background using a variety of forensic analysis tools in incident response investigations to determine the extent and scope of compromise.
  • Systems Administration: an understanding of system internals is required to understand how to implement and execute countermeasures and remediation.
  • Network Forensic Analysis: knowledge of network protocols, network analysis tools, and ability to perform analysis of associated network logs.
  • Malware Analysis: ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis to understand the nature of malware.
  • Incident Remediation: strong understanding of targeted attacks and able to create customised tactical and strategic remediation plans for compromised organisations.
  • Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: strong understanding of secure network architecture and strong background in performing network operations.
  • Emerging and Innovative Technologies: understanding of applications and uses of Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning in the cyber security domain.



What You Can Expect:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Paid holidays (including birthday holidays) and 401k matching (where applicable)

  • Professional development opportunities including workshops, tech talks, and Executive Speaker Series

  • Assigned mentors from across the company for continuous support and feedback

  • Participation in companywide initiatives including FalconFIT, Wellness Programs, and Employee Assistance Program

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Ownership of impactful projects that move the company forward

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

raw.description:
Chief Program Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Program Officer (CPO) is responsible for overseeing the organization's strategic programs, enterprise-wide initiatives, and complex, multi-project portfolios across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that major programs are strategically aligned, properly resourced, effectively governed, and successfully delivered within approved timelines and budgets. The CPO will establish program management standards, coordinate cross-functional teams, manage interdependent projects, and ensure that strategic initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team, the CPO will translate corporate priorities into coordinated programs that support business growth, operational excellence, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and organizational development.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Management

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide program management strategy.
  • Identify, structure, prioritize, and oversee strategic programs aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Translate organizational strategies into coordinated programs with clear goals, milestones, deliverables, and expected outcomes.
  • Manage interdependencies between projects, business units, and strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with organizational priorities.

Insurance & Investment Program Delivery

  • Lead strategic programs involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee programs related to insurance product development, underwriting modernization, claims transformation, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Coordinate investment-related programs involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Manage initiatives involving regulatory changes, new business models, market expansion, and operational restructuring.
  • Ensure program deliverables address business requirements and relevant industry regulations.

Program Governance & Management Office

  • Establish and oversee program governance frameworks, methodologies, policies, and reporting standards.
  • Develop program charters, business cases, implementation plans, risk registers, and performance dashboards.
  • Implement structured review processes, approval mechanisms, escalation procedures, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure consistency in program management practices across subsidiaries and business units.
  • Work with the Project Management Office (PMO) to coordinate individual project delivery and maintain portfolio visibility.

Program Budget & Resource Management

  • Develop and oversee program budgets, resource plans, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor program expenditure, financial performance, and budget variations.
  • Ensure effective allocation of people, technology, and financial resources across programs.
  • Evaluate program business cases, cost-benefit analysis, expected returns, and benefits realization.
  • Manage external consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and implementation partners.

Digital & Business Transformation Programs

  • Lead cross-functional programs involving digital transformation, automation, AI, cloud adoption, and enterprise system modernization.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, CRM systems, and investment service technologies.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leaders to ensure technology programs deliver business value.
  • Oversee business process redesign, operational improvement, and organizational change initiatives.
  • Monitor adoption, implementation effectiveness, and long-term program outcomes.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Identify, assess, and manage program-level operational, financial, regulatory, and technology risks.
  • Ensure programs comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Coordinate with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams.
  • Establish mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and escalation mechanisms.
  • Monitor program quality and ensure deliverables meet approved standards.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Collaborate with the CEO, Board, executive leadership, and business unit heads to define program priorities.
  • Coordinate communication and collaboration among project sponsors, program managers, and key stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with regulators, external consultants, strategic partners, and implementation vendors, as appropriate.
  • Resolve conflicts involving program scope, resource allocation, timelines, and competing business priorities.
  • Present program progress, financial performance, key risks, and strategic recommendations to senior management.

Leadership & Program Management Excellence

  • Lead and develop program directors, program managers, project managers, and program delivery teams.
  • Build a high-performing program management function with clear accountability and performance standards.
  • Establish training, mentoring, and professional development initiatives.
  • Promote consistent program management methodologies and continuous improvement.
  • Introduce tools and reporting systems to improve program visibility, coordination, and delivery effectiveness.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Program Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in program management, project portfolio management, enterprise transformation, or strategic initiative delivery.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing large-scale, multi-project programs.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services preferred.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs with measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of program governance, project management methodologies, budgeting, risk management, and resource planning.
  • Experience establishing or leading enterprise program management offices.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, PMI, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent leadership, strategic planning, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of strategic programs delivered on time and within budget.
  • Program performance against approved strategic objectives.
  • Achievement of program milestones and deliverables.
  • Program budget variance and resource utilization.
  • Benefits realization and return on investment (ROI).
  • Effective management of project interdependencies.
  • Program risk mitigation and issue resolution effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive reporting quality.
  • Compliance with program governance and reporting standards.
  • Successful delivery of digital, operational, and business transformation programs.
  • Reduction in program delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.
