raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Senior Jira / Jira Service Management (JSM) System Administrator to support the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Water Mission Area (WMA) under a federal IT services contract. In this role, you will serve as an embedded operations specialist responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, and user support of USGS's Jira and JSM platforms, the central issue-tracking and service-desk infrastructure for one of the nation's most critical scientific agencies. You will play a key role in supporting an enterprise-scale migration from Jira Data Center to Atlassian Government Cloud (AGC), maintaining high availability and service quality across a distributed user base, and ensuring full compliance with Federal IT security and accessibility standards. This is a fully remote, U.S.-based position working standard Eastern Time business hours in direct support of a federal Government customer.

The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Water Mission Area (WMA) is one of the federal government's most vital scientific programs, responsible for delivering the nation's water data, including streamflow and groundwater levels, water quality, and drought monitoring, to inform decisions that affect communities across the country. To support the hundreds of scientists, engineers, and field personnel who power this mission, the WMA relies on a modern, cloud-hosted application ecosystem centered on Atlassian Jira and Jira Service Management. Peraton supports the WMA through a long-term federal IT operations contract, currently at the forefront of a significant digital modernization initiative migrating the WMA's enterprise work management environment from Jira Data Center to the Atlassian Government Cloud (AGC). This multi-year effort will shape how one of America's premier scientific agencies operates for years to come.

Work Location: Remote

What You Will Do:

  • Administer Atlassian Jira and Jira Service Management at the site and project levels, including workflows, schemes, custom fields, and automation rules
  • Manage the full lifecycle of third-party Jira plugins, including installation, patching, licensing, and security review
  • Deliver project-level Jira training and technical guidance to end users and administrators
  • Coordinate configuration changes with USGS product owners, developers, and system architects
  • Support migration of WMA workflows, data, and processes from Jira Data Center to Atlassian Government Cloud (AGC)
  • Assist WMA teams with adoption of cloud-native AGC features and coordinate with other USGS Jira administrators in the shared AGC environment
  • Perform SOP-driven daily operational checks and maintain centralized knowledge base articles, SOPs, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides
  • Maintain WMA application inventories including dependencies, version histories, and licensing terms
  • Respond to service requests within 8 business hours and manage ticket triage, escalation, and resolution
  • Utilize Government-designated monitoring tools including Zabbix, nmap, CloudCheckr, and BigFix
  • Distribute outage notifications within 4 hours of identification, run daily standups, and deliver meeting notes within 5 business days
  • Author root cause analysis reports for critical events and contribute to after-action reviews and SLO impact reporting
  • Comply with FISMA, NIST, Section 508, and Privacy Act requirements applicable to individual privileged users
  • Complete DOI annual security awareness training and perform all work on Government Furnished Equipment (GFE)

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree and 5 years of professional experience, or a high school diploma/equivalent and 11 years of professional experience.

  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
  • Strong hands-on Atlassian Jira administration at the project and/or site-administrator level
  • Demonstrated experience administering Jira Service Management (JSM), including service desk configuration and SLA management
  • Experience managing third-party Jira plugins through their full lifecycle
  • Experience supporting or executing a Jira Data Center to cloud migration
  • Experience working in a federal or regulated IT environment with FISMA or NIST compliance requirements
  • Working knowledge of Jira Query Language (JQL) and Atlassian Cloud or AGC administration
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools including Zabbix, nmap, CloudCheckr, and/or BigFix
  • Must be U.S.-based; available 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field strongly preferred.
  • Atlassian Certified Professional (Jira Administration, Server or Cloud)
  • ITIL Foundation v4 or higher
  • CompTIA Security+ or equivalent DoD 8570/8140-compliant certification
  • Prior experience supporting USGS, DOI, or other Department of the Interior IT environments
  • Experience with Atlassian Government Cloud (AGC) FedRAMP-authorized configurations
  • Familiarity with NIST RMF, DOI SDLC, and POA&M management processes
  • Experience writing Accessibility Conformance Reports (VPAT v2.1+)

Target Salary Range

Job Title: Associate Director, Device Regulatory Affairs

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

About This Role:


As the Associate Director of Device Regulatory Affairs, you will be at the forefront of leading regulatory strategies and execution for Class III medical device submissions across the United States, European Union, and United Kingdom. You will manage a team of 2 global regulatory affairs staff, ensuring that all regulatory plans, submission content, and approval strategies are meticulously developed and aligned with high-risk device programs. Your role is pivotal in serving as a senior regulatory representative in interactions with key health authorities, including FDA, EU notified bodies, and UK approved bodies, to ensure timely and compliant responses. Collaborating cross-functionally with teams such as Quality, Clinical, Medical Safety, Engineering, and Manufacturing, you will integrate regulatory requirements into product lifecycle planning and global commercialization strategies. Your contributions will be vital in maintaining compliance and facilitating market access for innovative medical devices.

What You’ll Do:


  • Lead global regulatory strategy for Class III medical device programs, including developing integrated regulatory pathways and submission plans.
  • Direct preparation, review, and execution of major regulatory submissions for Class III devices.
  • Serve as a senior regulatory lead for interactions with FDA, EU notified bodies, UK approved bodies, and other global health authorities.
  • Provide regulatory leadership for product development, design changes, manufacturing changes, labeling, clinical evidence, and risk management.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into actionable program plans and submission-ready deliverables.
  • Monitor evolving US and international device regulations, guidance, and standards, assessing business impact and driving implementation of regulatory intelligence.
  • Lead and mentor global regulatory staff and cross-functional teams, providing governance, issue escalation, and inspection/readiness support.

Who You Are:


You are a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of regulatory affairs for Class III medical devices. Your attention to detail and ability to navigate complex regulations allows you to effectively lead and mentor teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment, valuing cross-functional partnerships to achieve business goals. Your proactive approach and dedication to compliance ensure that you stay ahead of evolving regulatory landscapes, driving successful submissions and approvals.


Required Skills:


  • Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs for Class III implantable medical devices.
  • At least 5 years of experience with combination product implantable medical devices.
  • Experience with FDA submissions and EU MDR technical documentation.
  • Familiarity with global commercialization strategies for medical devices.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.

Preferred Skills:


  • Advanced degree
Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $160,000.00-$220,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.


At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.

Associate Director - Real World Biostatistics

As an Associate Director - Real World Biostatistics,you will lead the design and delivery of biostatistical methods and analyses for real-world data to support access and patient impact in the United States. The role advises on and applies advanced biostatistical methods and AI tools to real world data (RWD) to generate real world evidence (RWE) for informing trial design, regulatory submissions, reimbursement and safety signals. You will collaborate closely with diverse teams across medical affairs, epidemiology, health economics, market access, and external partners. We value candidates who are curious, collaborative, and communicate clearly. This role offers meaningful impact, strong career growth, and a chance to align with GSK’s mission of uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

This role is fully remote in the US or the UK.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  • Lead statistical design and analysis for real-world evidence studies using large healthcare data sets.
  • Translate stakeholder questions into study protocols and statistical analysis plans that address bias and study limitations.
  • Manage study execution, including timelines, budgets, quality control, and vendor coordination.
  • Develop and review analytic code ensuring reproducibility and quality using programming tools such as R or SAS.
  • Communicate results clearly to internal teams and external audiences, supporting publications and payer dossiers.
  • Mentor junior biostatisticians and contribute to best practices across evidence generation teams.

Basic Qualifications:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


  • Master’s degree or PhD in biostatistics, epidemiology, statistics, data science, or related quantitative field.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience applying biostatistics to real-world data, pharmacoepidemiology, or health outcomes research.

Preferred Qualifications:

Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:


  • PhD in biostatistics, epidemiology, or related discipline.
  • Practical experience with programming languages such as R and/or SAS and reproducible analysis workflows.
  • Experience working with large US real-world data sources such as insurance claims, electronic health records, or registries.
  • Prior experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry supporting access, reimbursement, or regulatory decisions.
  • A track record of peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or contributions to methodological guidelines.
  • Familiarity with advanced causal inference methods, propensity score techniques, or longitudinal modeling.
  • Strong knowledge of observational study design, causal inference methods, and methods to address bias.
  • Experience mentoring and developing junior biostatisticians or early career scientists.
  • Experience working in matrix environments with cross-functional teams and managing vendors.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to clearly explain technical results to non-technical audiences.


Skills

Cross-Functional Leadership, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, Evidence Based Decision Making, Flexible Mindset, High Impact Communication, Launch Excellence, Patient JourneyThe US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $141,750 to $236,250. Performs work that involves a high degree of independence. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing, and performing work. Seeks to continually improve territory efficiency.

raw.excerpt: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English.
raw.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit. 

About the project 

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result. 

About the roles 

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets. 

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus. 

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context. 

Who we are looking for 

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English. 

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language 

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role. 

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail. 

Project at a glance 

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November 

  • Languages: Dutch

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person 

  • Project compensation: US$80-US$92.5 per hour

  • Work location: fully remote 

How selection works (major steps) 

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability. 

  2. Language test: short exercises in the target language. 

  3. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track. 

  4. Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role. 

  5. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

Job Description: Director of PMO – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Director of Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for establishing, leading, and managing the organization's Project Management Office to ensure effective governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of strategic and operational projects.

The role oversees the project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate operations, technology, digital transformation, and business development functions. The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

C. Project Planning & Execution

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

D. Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.
  • Coordinate initiatives involving investment operations, financial products, portfolio reporting, and client services, where applicable.
  • Support the implementation of regulatory, compliance, risk management, and internal control initiatives.
  • Monitor projects involving new product development, market expansion, operational improvements, and business integration.
  • Ensure project deliverables reflect the operational and regulatory requirements of the insurance and financial services industry.

E. Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Oversee technology-enabled transformation projects, including core insurance systems, CRM, ERP, digital platforms, and automation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with IT, technology, operations, and business teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor technology project budgets, vendor performance, implementation timelines, and delivery quality.
  • Support digitalization, process automation, data management, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Ensure technology projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

F. Financial & Resource Management

  • Develop and monitor project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure reports.
  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources.
  • Monitor project costs, financial variances, and budget performance.
  • Evaluate project financial risks and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement teams on project funding, contracts, and vendor payments.
  • Assess project return on investment (ROI) and benefits realization.

G. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Establish project risk management frameworks and escalation mechanisms.
  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
  • Monitor project quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
  • Maintain project documentation, audit trails, and management records.
  • Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.

H. Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting

  • Develop project dashboards, management reports, and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Present project status, risks, budget performance, and delivery updates to executive leadership.
  • Provide timely visibility into project delays, resource constraints, and critical dependencies.
  • Monitor project KPIs and ensure accountability among project managers.
  • Lead project review meetings and portfolio governance sessions.
  • Recommend improvements to project delivery processes and organizational performance.

I. Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop project managers, PMO analysts, and project support professionals.
  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, department heads, project sponsors, and external vendors.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination across business units and functional teams.
  • Develop project management capabilities through training, coaching, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, Finance, or a relevant discipline is preferred.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive professional experience in project management, program management, or portfolio management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership or Director-level position.
  • Proven experience establishing, managing, or transforming a Project Management Office.
  • Experience overseeing complex, enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Background in insurance, banking, financial services, investment management, or related industries is highly desirable.
  • Experience managing large project portfolios, budgets, resources, and multiple project teams.
  • Exposure to digital transformation, technology implementation, business process improvement, and organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Managing Successful Programmes (MSP).

  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

- Lean Six Sigma certification.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic project and portfolio management.
  • PMO governance and operational leadership.
  • Financial planning and budget management.

- Risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder management.
  • Change management and business transformation.
  • Leadership, team development, and decision-making.
  • Project management systems and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance and delivery success rate.

- Project cost and schedule variance.

  • Achievement of project milestones and strategic objectives.

- Project benefits realization and ROI.

  • Effectiveness of project governance and reporting.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and project sponsor feedback.
  • PMO process maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Compliance with project management standards and regulatory requirements.

raw.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Seeking a Financial Analytics Lead with deep healthcare analytics expertise to lead valuation, forecasting, methodology development, and analytical decision support.
raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Seeking a Financial Analytics Lead with deep healthcare analytics expertise to lead valuation, forecasting, methodology development, and analytical decision support. This role centers on financial model ownership for Medicare Advantage and Risk Adjustment programs and provides insights that inform strategic and operational decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines advanced SQL-based analytics with deep financial modeling capabilities, including the ability to independently develop, build, modify, validate, and analyze financial models used to project risk-score-driven revenue and evaluate program performance. The role requires translating evolving business requirements, methodologies, and data into scalable analytical models and using those models to inform critical business decisions.

This position is an individual contributor role with significant responsibility for leading cross-functional efforts, mentoring team members, reviewing analytical work, and driving alignment across stakeholders. The role requires influence without formal direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, enhancement, validation, and ongoing performance of forecasting and valuation models.
  • Translate Medicare Advantage, Risk Adjustment, operational, and financial requirements into model logic and analytical methodologies.
  • Independently write complex SQL to manipulate and analyze data.
  • Build and enhance forecasting model assumptions and methodologies.
  • Evaluate Medicare Advantage and Risk Adjustment program performance.
  • Lead analytical initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
  • Influence business decisions without formal authority.

Analytical Leadership & Initiative Ownership

  • Lead complex analytical initiatives from problem definition through implementation.
  • Define analytical approaches, methodologies, assumptions, and success measures in situations with limited guidance or evolving business requirements.
  • Mentor team members, review analytical work products, and promote analytical best practices across the team.
  • Drive alignment among stakeholders while balancing competing priorities and business objectives.
  • Translate ambiguous business challenges into actionable analytical solutions.
  • Own recurring valuation, performance measurement, and reporting processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, scalable, and well documented.

Data Validation & Performance Measurement

  • Validate source data, assumptions, calculations, and reporting outputs to ensure analytical accuracy.
  • Investigate unexpected trends and analyze root causes.
  • Reconcile findings across multiple data sources and methodologies.
  • Establish quality control procedures for recurring financial and operational reporting.

Financial Modeling, Forecasting & Analytics

  • Independently develop, build, modify, validate, and analyze financial models used to project risk-score-driven revenue, estimate program value, and support forecasting and business decision-making.
  • Translate Medicare Advantage risk adjustment methodologies, operational assumptions, emerging business requirements, and source data into financial model logic and analytical frameworks.
  • Understand model architecture and calculation logic sufficiently to diagnose unexpected results, trace outcomes to underlying assumptions and data, and determine appropriate methodological or technical changes.
  • Evaluate and enhance model assumptions, segmentation, aggregation, projection methodologies, and analytical techniques to improve estimation accuracy and decision usefulness.
  • Assess the financial implications of changes in risk score performance, operational results, assumptions, methodology, and other relevant business drivers.
  • Partner with business leaders, program owners, and analytical teams to align on objectives, assumptions, methodologies, and recommended actions.

Leadership Communication & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Help leaders and stakeholders understand valuation assumptions, risks, limitations, methodology changes, and performance trends.
  • Collaborate closely with Finance, Operations, and Analytics teams while maintaining analytical objectivity and rigor.
  • Influence decisions through data, business judgment, trusted stakeholder relationships, and effective communication.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in healthcare analytics, financial analytics, consulting, strategy, or related analytical disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience developing financial models, valuation methodologies, or forecasting frameworks.
  • Experience leading complex analytical initiatives with significant business impact.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Advanced SQL proficiency with demonstrated ability to independently write, troubleshoot, and optimize complex queries against large relational datasets.
  • Advanced financial modeling proficiency with demonstrated ability to independently build, modify, troubleshoot, validate, and analyze complex forecasting and revenue projection models.
  • Ability to translate business rules, financial assumptions, analytical methodologies, and changing requirements into model logic implemented through SQL, Excel, or related analytical tools.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency, including Pivot Tables, data validation, reconciliation, trend analysis, and synthesis of large datasets into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of forecasting, statistical analysis, and valuation concepts with the ability to implement enhancements into SQL and Excel models.
  • Ability to work across disparate data sources and varying levels of analytical granularity.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to validate assumptions, methodologies, and results.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare Advantage and Risk Adjustment methodology, including the ability to evaluate program performance and interpret key drivers of financial outcomes.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience presenting results and recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing valuation methodologies used to assess strategic initiatives or operational programs.
  • Familiarity with predictive modeling, regression analysis, causal inference, machine learning, or other advanced analytical methodologies.
  • Experience evaluating program effectiveness and measuring business impact.
  • Experience building scalable analytical processes and governance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting enterprise transformation, value realization, or strategic investment initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A Financial Analytics Lead should be able to independently understand, develop, build, modify, validate, troubleshoot, and improve complex financial models, applying sound analytical judgment to adapt model methodologies and assumptions as data, business requirements, and operating conditions change.

The strongest candidate thrives in ambiguous environments and can independently transform loosely defined business questions into structured analytical approaches. They are equally comfortable writing complex SQL queries, building and enhancing forecasting models, evaluating program performance, and defending analytical conclusions with data-driven evidence. They challenge assumptions, identify opportunities to improve methodologies, and build credibility through analytical rigor, sound judgment, and effective collaboration. They naturally lead analytical initiatives, help align stakeholders around solutions, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.

Success in This Role

Within the first year, successful candidates will:

  • Independently assume ownership of complex financial models used to project risk-score-driven revenue, including understanding existing model architecture, validating assumptions and calculations, implementing enhancements, troubleshooting unexpected results, and adapting models as business requirements evolve.
  • Challenge assumptions and navigate ambiguity while simultaneously aligning on solutions based on collaboratively shared insights.
  • Become a trusted analytical partner to Risk Adjustment and business leadership teams.
  • Independently perform complex SQL-based analyses to evaluate program performance and financial outcomes.
  • Improve valuation methodologies and forecasting approaches through thoughtful analysis and business partnership.
  • Establish confidence in financial reporting through rigorous validation and documentation practices.
  • Influence operational decisions by providing actionable insights supported by quantitative evidence.
  • Develop sustainable, scalable analytical and reporting processes that reduce manual effort while improving transparency and consistency.

This role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship.

raw.description:
Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

raw.description:
Specialty Networks is an integrated, multi-specialty organization with GPOs, Life Sciences, and Research solutions in Urology, Oncology, Gastroenterology, and Rheumatology. Specialty Networks solutions include population health management, patient engagement, clinical research, and workflow automation technologies to achieve Center of Excellence status in Standards of Care, Clinical Research, Practice Operations, and Value-based Care. Specialty Networks leverages the Power of its Network, represented by over 10,000 providers, to help independent physician practices, industry, wholesalers/distributors, payers, and policymakers improve patient outcomes.

What Data Science contributes to Cardinal Health

The Data & Analytics Function oversees the analytics lifecycle in order to identify, analyze and present relevant insights that drive business decisions and anticipate opportunities to achieve a competitive advantage. This function manages analytic data platforms, the access, design and implementation of reporting/business intelligence solutions, and the application of advanced quantitative modeling.

Data Science applies base, scientific methodologies from various disciplines, techniques and tools that extracts knowledge and insight from data to solve complex business problems on large data sets, integrating multiple systems.

Job Summary

The Sr. Data Scientist in Specialty Networks Solutions leads the design, hardening, and deployment of high-impact real-world data (RWD) products and advanced analytical solutions for biopharmaceutical partners. Acting at the intersection of clinical informatics, data engineering, and biopharma client strategy, this individual is directly responsible for ensuring clinical data quality, optimizing data availability, and unlocking measurable commercial and clinical value for life sciences clients. The role requires deep domain expertise across healthcare data ecosystems (electronic health records, medical/pharmacy claims, specialty pharmacy dispensing, lab registries), sophisticated quantitative and machine learning capabilities, and a rigorous engineering approach to transforming prototype analyses into resilient, production-grade data products.

Responsibilities

Data Governance & Standards

  • Define governed definitions for the highest-priority derived variables
  • Set Quality Control rules for each transformation step in datasets, profile the raw and transformed data hands-on, and trace anomalies to root cause
  • Document the pipeline and data model, including the decision logic at each transformation step
  • Harden data assets and analytical pipelines to ensure production reliability, regulatory defensibility, and reproducibility across client-facing deliverables

Engineering Partnership

  • Assess engineering delivery meets client and quality requirements, and close gaps (e.g., order data not flowing into deliverables)
  • Run a shared request queue for questions from clients and internal analysts, and track each item with engineering
  • Identify key growth areas from the market to enhance data pipelines both in structured and unstructured data sources
  • Prioritize workflows to deliver more value through product generation
  • Accelerate data accessibility by standardizing common data models (e.g., OMOP, clinical registries) and enabling rapid extraction of fit-for-purpose real-world evidence (RWE)

Client & Strategic Partnership

  • Join discovery conversations alongside the delivery team, and build prototype dashboards on real data (e.g., a patient journey) as the specification for engineering
  • Facilitate listening sessions with key biopharmaceutical partner clients to understand existing and future challenges.
  • Present analytical findings, data methodologies, and strategic recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of data science, advanced analytics, healthcare data, or real-world evidence, including experience supporting biopharmaceutical client, preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, required
  • Advanced degree in measurement, statistics, epidemiology, or a related field, preferred
  • Demonstrated expertise working with complex healthcare datasets, including electronic health records (EHR), medical and pharmacy claims, specialty pharmacy data, laboratory and genomic data, and patient identity/tokenization solutions such as Datavant.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and at least one statistical or programming language such as R or Python, with experience working in modern data platforms including Databricks.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data models, clinical concepts, patient journeys, provider and drug mapping, and real-world evidence methodologies.
  • Proven experience identifying, investigating, and resolving complex data quality and system-level issues through rigorous analytical and root-cause analysis techniques.
  • Experience translating business and client requirements into technical specifications and collaborating with engineering teams to deliver scalable data products.
  • Demonstrated success influencing stakeholders and driving outcomes in highly matrixed, cross-functional organizations.
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills, with the ability to effectively present complex analytical concepts to technical and executive audiences.

Location: This position is remote, based anywhere within the United States. Candidates must be able to work within the EST or CST business hours, as needed.

Bonus eligible: Yes

raw.title: Head of Sales
raw.excerpt: TL;DR Harper is entering its next phase of growth, and you'll be on the leadership team driving it.
raw.description:
TL;DR Harper is entering its next phase of growth, and you'll be on the leadership team driving it. We build technology that is genuinely different: one runtime for data, messaging and compute, running close to the user, built for the real time and AI workloads that older stacks were never designed for. Customers and partners already verified strong product market fit. We need a leader to take it to a much bigger share of the market.

The Head of Sales is Harper's hunter and closer. You'll pick up the phone, open new accounts, and close deals yourself, then build a small team around you. You report to the CEO, remote, with high ownership and a number you carry personally.

You won't inherit a big sales machine or a long playbook. You'll bring your own network, decide where Harper plays first, hire sellers you trust, and write the playbook as you win.

Why Harper

Harper is a distributed application platform that puts data, messaging and compute in one runtime, close to the user. Teams use it to replace stitched together stacks with a single system that is faster, simpler to run, and built for real time and AI driven workloads.

Where Harper is winning today:

  • Commerce and digital experience. Retailers use Harper to serve dynamic, personalized pages and to move off legacy front end and back end stacks. Fortune 10 retailers have migrated both layers to Harper, and have replaced incumbent delivery technology with it.
  • Real time messaging and IoT. Automotive, telecom and airline customers run MQTT messaging on Harper, with data and messaging in the same system.
  • AI and agent workloads. AI applications need fast, shared, durable state and live connections. Harper provides that layer, and customers are already building on it.

Harper also has strong partners and a deep engineering team. You'll arrive at a moment when a new CEO is setting the company's go-to-market direction, and you'll help shape it.

Role Overview

The Head of Sales is Harper's revenue leader -the person who owns the number and the sales motion that produces it. You'll own new business, the pipeline and the committed forecast, and you'll lead how Harper sells through partners. Our go-to-market runs through a growing set of channel and cloud partners, alongside direct enterprise deals. You'll make sure partner relationships turn into qualified opportunities, signed paper, and revenue we can forecast.

You'll work closely with the CEO, Operations (RevOps and deal desk), Finance, Marketing, and our field engineering team, who front much of our technical selling today. You'll lead the Enterprise Account Manager and shape the next sales hires.

We move fast, wear many hats, and value people who flex to get things done. You won't inherit a sales playbook for most things; instead you'll help write it.

Key Responsibilities

New Business

  • Build and work a list of named target accounts that fit our ideal customer profile.
  • Generate qualified opportunities every quarter against a scorecard agreed with the CEO.
  • Lead with Harper's named use-case solutions and bundles, so buyers understand what they're buying and what it costs.
  • Run every pilot on standard terms with clear success criteria, and convert pilots to paid.
  • Help identify early customers for AI-adjacent workloads as Harper tests that market.

What success looks like: A steady flow of qualified, well-fit opportunities, and pilots that end in signed contracts.

Channel & Partner Revenue

  • Partner with our Partnerships lead to turn channel relationships into sourced pipeline and closed deals.
  • Co-sell on a joint target account list, and grow revenue from new channel and cloud partners.
  • Put deal registration and partner attribution in place so partner-sourced revenue is counted the same way every time.
  • Make sure each new partner has signed paper, clear fees and a support model before its pipeline counts.

What success looks like: A growing share of new ARR comes from partners.

Enterprise Accounts & Expansion

  • Lead the Enterprise Account Manager, who owns our largest accounts day to day.
  • Protect gross revenue retention, and drive expansion through new use cases in existing accounts.

What success looks like: Our anchor customers stay and grow, and the revenue base gets broader every quarter.

Pipeline & Forecast

  • Write stage exit criteria for every opportunity stage, and require a close plan and paper path on every deal.
  • Run a weekly pipeline review on clean Salesforce data: no default amounts, nothing sitting static for 30+ days.
  • Own the committed forecast, and keep one number across Salesforce, the forecast and Finance's operating model.
  • Measure stage conversion and win rate, and use closed-lost data to sharpen where we play.

What success looks like: Leadership and the board trust the forecast, and quarterly ARR lands close to what we committed.

Team, Comp & Enablement

  • Build the sales team: shape and hire the next revenue roles once you're in seat.
  • Design commission plans with Operations and Finance that tie variable pay to company goals.
  • Enable the field engineers and solutions team who front deals on discovery, business cases, and running a pilot to a decision.
  • Partner with Marketing on sales enablement: one page and one price per solution that a partner rep can sell from.

What success looks like: A small, accountable team that sells the same way, paid on results that matter to the company.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • New business closed, and growing qualified pipeline you created yourself.
  • Revenue is diversified across a broader set of customers and partners, and retention holds.
  • The committed forecast is one number across sales, finance and the board, and actuals land close to it.
  • Pilots run on standard terms and convert to paid contracts.
  • New deals land at or above the gross margin target.
  • The sales team is hired, enabled and paid on plans tied to company goals.

What This Role Is Not

This role is intentionally different from many traditional sales leadership positions. To ensure clarity and alignment, it is important to understand what this role is not:

  • Not a big-company VP of Sales seat. There's no large team underneath you and no established playbook. You'll be in deals yourself while you build the process around them.
  • Not a pure channel manager role. Partners are central to how we sell, but you own the revenue outcome, not just the relationships.
  • Not a technical pre-sales role. You'll work closely with our engineers and solutions team, but your center of gravity is qualifying, closing and forecasting.
  • Not a volume or transactional sales role. We sell considered, enterprise deals with pilots, multiple stakeholders and partner involvement.
  • Not a forecast built on hope. We need someone who calls the number honestly and holds the team to clear stages and evidence.

Qualifications

Required

  • Enterprise infrastructure software sales (top priority). 10+ years selling enterprise software, with significant time selling databases, data platforms, CDN, cloud or developer infrastructure to large enterprises.
  • Sales leadership. 3+ years leading quota-carrying sellers or account managers, including setting quotas and running a forecast.
  • Closed deals yourself. You have personally closed new enterprise deals in the last 12 months. This is a player-coach seat.
  • A network. Buyers and sellers you can call, and recruit from.
  • Channel and partner-led selling. You've closed meaningful revenue with or through partners such as CDNs, hyperscalers, resellers or systems integrators, and you know how attribution and co-selling actually work.
  • Forecast discipline. You've worked with sales operations to develop a pipeline review process including qualification criteria, and your committed forecasts have held up.
  • Complex deal experience. You've closed six-figure, multi-stakeholder deals with pilots or proofs of concept, including usage- or consumption-based pricing.
  • Commercial and pricing judgment. You understand deal economics and gross margin, and you hold a price floor.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You thrive in fast-moving, early-stage environments and hold yourself accountable for outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills. You can sell to technical and business buyers, and you can give the CEO and board a clear, honest view of the number.

Preferred

  • Experience selling with or through Akamai, Fastly, AWS, GCP or a global systems integrator.
  • Experience selling to large retail and commerce companies, where speed and data freshness drive revenue.
  • Experience building a sales function at a venture- or PE-backed company, including the first commission plans.
  • Experience with edge computing, real-time data, or caching and data delivery solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and HubSpot.
  • Familiarity with AI and agent workloads, and the infrastructure behind them.
  • Fluency with AI tools to speed up research, account planning and forecasting.

Tools We Use

Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom.

Why This Role Matters at Harper

The Head of Sales is how Harper turns a strong platform and strong partnerships into revenue it can count on. Our 2027 plan bets on a repeatable revenue engine in edge commerce, a broader set of partners, and profitable growth on every new dollar. This role owns the heart of that bet: a pipeline we can forecast, partners who source real deals, and a team that sells the same way every time. As Harper scales through partnerships and enterprise growth, strong sales leadership is what lets us grow with confidence.

Compensation

  • Base: $225,000–$325,000
  • On-target earnings (base plus variable): $375,000–$540,000 at a 60/40 base-to-variable split. Variable is tied to new business closed against the committed number.
Salary: $225,000 – $325,000 / year

  3. Demonstrated skill evaluating benefit claims and applying program rules in a regulated environment.
  4. Experience using claims processing and case management systems, such as SSA’s MCS and MSSICS, or similar platforms.
  5. Background in quality assurance for claims or similar processes within federal, state, or related agencies.
  6. Ability to synthesize complex information and present informed decisions for higher-level review processes.

raw.description:
The Amazon Account Manager runs day-to-day operations of Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for Hustler Marketing's clients, manages Amazon PPC advertising, and owns the client relationship. The goal is simple: help each client sell more, profitably, on Amazon.

You will work across multiple brands and marketplaces, mainly the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. You will analyze sales, inventory, and advertising data, find what is limiting growth, recommend what to do, and make it happen. You will also be the client’s main point of contact.

Amazon changes constantly, so much of this role is solving problems no one has written instructions for. You will have the support of the wider team, training on our processes, and regular feedback to help you grow.

About the Role

Mission statement

Keep our clients’ Amazon accounts running accurately and grow their businesses through sound operations, effective advertising, data-driven decisions, and proactive communication.

Sales on Amazon come from a few fundamentals: stock availability, listing quality, advertising, pricing, and promotions. You will own these for the accounts you handle, understand each client’s objectives, recommend priorities, and make sure agreed actions are delivered.

General Responsibilities

Operations

  • Manage day-to-day Seller Central and Vendor Central operations across marketplaces
  • Forecast demand from sales history, calculate replenishment quantities, and prevent stockouts
  • Identify excess inventory and recommend actions
  • Create and coordinate shipments to Amazon warehouses
  • Support product launches and set up promotions
  • Upload and optimize product content to improve listing quality
  • Monitor listings, investigate issues and resolve them with Amazon Support

Advertising

  • Set up, manage and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns
  • Conduct keyword research and search term analysis to find relevant targeting opportunities
  • Manage campaign structure, targeting, bids, budgets, placements and negative keywords
  • Track ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC and conversion rates, and judge them by their effect on overall profitability
  • Test new approaches, fix underperforming campaigns and reallocate budget to what works
  • Align advertising with inventory, pricing, promotions and launches

Clients and analysis

  • Act as the primary point of contact and build strong client relationships
  • Lead regular meetings on performance, challenges, opportunities and priorities
  • Develop account strategies based on each client’s goals and resources
  • Analyze performance across products, variations and categories to find trends and opportunities
  • Build clear reports and turn complex data into actionable recommendations
  • Set realistic timelines, give regular updates and follow through on commitments
  • Balance client requests with operational needs and team capacity

Improvement

  • Investigate unfamiliar problems to their root cause and find practical solutions
  • Improve account management processes for efficiency and accuracy
  • Collaborate with the team to align priorities and deliver strategies
  • Take part in regular training and feedback sessions

Position Specs

  • Fully remote position
  • Ready to start as soon as possible
  • Start on a probationary period at an hourly rate.
  • Opportunity to transition into a full-time position within the Amazon Operations team with a fixed-rate monthly salary following a successful probation period
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the probationary period
  • Vacation days based on your country of residence, plus national holidays
  • Regular training, feedback sessions, and professional development opportunities

Requirements

About You

Profile

You have hands-on experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central, Amazon PPC, and direct client communication. You understand what drives a brand’s sales on Amazon and can manage several accounts while balancing operations, advertising, and client needs.

You are comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can evaluate performance, calculate inventory needs, spot stock risks, and understand how metrics like ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS connect to the client’s overall business.

You are a resourceful problem-solver. When something unfamiliar comes up, you investigate, test possible solutions, and act. When things go wrong, you explain your reasoning to clients clearly and keep their confidence.

You are detail-oriented, organized, and accountable, and you can turn client objectives into clear plans. You are humble, open to feedback, comfortable working remotely, and motivated to grow your Amazon expertise.

Key Traits for This Position

  • Analytical: You reason from data, spot patterns, and back every recommendation with clear logic.
  • Commercially aware: You understand how operational and advertising decisions affect sales and profit, and you prioritize what matters most.
  • Client-focused: You lead conversations confidently, ask good questions, handle difficult discussions, and keep trust through transparency.
  • Curious and adaptable: You learn new processes quickly and work toward solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Ownership-driven: You are organized and accurate, follow through, and turn recommendations into measurable results.

Key Requirements

  • Practical experience with Seller Central or Vendor Central
  • Hands-on experience with Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display
  • Strong understanding of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates
  • Experience with keyword research, search term analysis, bids, budgets, and campaign structure
  • Understanding of inventory, shipments, promotions, product setup, and content
  • Experience handling operational issues and working with Amazon Support
  • Experience with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Amazon Ads Campaign Manager, or similar tools
  • Ability to work across multiple marketplaces and client brands
  • Strong spreadsheet skills
  • Ability to analyze sales and inventory data, calculate replenishment needs, and spot stockout or overstock risks
  • Understanding of how inventory, pricing, promotions, content, and advertising together drive sales
  • Ability to recognize missing information and identify the data needed to decide with confidence
  • Direct client experience, including leading meetings and presenting reports
  • Ability to explain recommendations clearly, manage expectations and set realistic timelines
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership and follow-through
  • Independent problem-solving with the judgement to ask for help when needed
  • Genuine interest in Amazon, e-commerce and digital marketing
  • Positive, humble, and collaborative, and open to feedback
  • Comfortable working remotely in a distributed team
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Fluency in additional European languages is a plus
  • Available to start as soon as possible
  • Long-term mindset and motivation to grow within the Amazon team

raw.description:
Give hope. Give health. Make your mark in the fight against cancer.

At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. But our commitment to innovation offers a truly unique opportunity: the chance to change the fight against cancer — helping to develop, introduce and support new treatment delivery systems and software that will give new hope and new health to cancer patients and cancer survivors around the world.

Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives.

Job Description

SUMMARY:

The Software Engineer participates in requirements, design, development, integration, and testing of software systems used to create, store, optimize, and manage patient treatment plans. The Software engineer collaborates in a complex environment integrating software with other software and hardware subsystems for an advanced medical device. Our work has a daily impact on patients worldwide, and we hold a high bar for quality and rigor.

REPORTING TO/DEPARTMENT:

Reports to the Manager, Software Engineering in the Software Engineering team

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Software Development (Build, Extend, Maintain)

  • Develop and maintain software that supports the lifecycle of a complex radiation therapy medical device.
  • Write high-quality, reliable code that fulfills product and subsystem requirements in a complex clinical domain.
  • Implement automated tests (unit/integration as appropriate) to validate functionality and reduce regressions.
  • Contribute to sustaining engineering by troubleshooting, participating in root-cause analysis, and resolving issues found in new or existing functionality.

Software Design & Architecture (Make the System Better)

  • Directly impact the development and architecture of software that creates, stores, optimizes and delivers patient treatments.
  • Drive critical design and implementation decisions and participate in design discussions for complex systems.
  • Present concise designs through written and oral reviews; contribute to clear documentation of designs, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Contribute to subsystem requirements and verification approaches for new features.

Performance & Computational Solutions (Accuracy + Responsiveness)

  • Participate in decisions affecting high-performance computation solutions to provide responsive and accurate results that meet clinical expectations.
  • Collaborate on technology choices (e.g., languages/libraries, compute approaches) to support performance, maintainability, and testability.

Quality, Compliance, and Ways of Working

  • Work closely with team members to implement quality applications that meet or exceed rigorous testing expectations.
  • Operate effectively in a regulated industry with strict process requirements; document work and follow the defined development processes.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts (e.g., coding standards, code reviews, test coverage, build/test automation) to increase engineering efficiency without sacrificing quality.

Collaboration & Technical Contribution

  • Collaborate across disciplines (software, systems, test, product, clinical/field stakeholders as needed) to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Cross-pollinate the team with theory and practice of software development, object-oriented design, and computer languages.
  • Proactively share information and communicate technical status, risks, and decisions to the right audience at the right level of detail.

Travel

  • Some travel (<10%) may be required.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Proficiency in an object-oriented programming language such as C#, Java or C++.
  • Experience with simulators and scaffolding for testing interoperability with third-party system specifications.
  • Experience with object-oriented analysis & design, including correct use of design patterns and awareness of anti-patterns. Experience with client/server architecture. Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present and defend designs in reviews.
  • Must be able to work effectively in a team environment

Preferred

  • Experience with interoperability concerns such as Semantic Modeling and Data Exchange protocols such as DICOM, HL7v2 and FHIR.
  • Experience with Medical Device development or other regulated environments.
  • Experience with Python or related languages.
  • Experience with client / server architecture.
  • Strong mathematics and/or physics background.
  • Experience developing software in multi-threaded / multi-core environments.
  • Experience with modern software practices and toolchains (e.g., configuration management such as Perforce/Git; CI/CD build, deployment, and test tooling).

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Indoor Environment: The position takes place indoors, providing a comfortable and climate-controlled workspace.
  • Sedentary Work: This role involves extended periods of sitting and working at a desk, requiring good ergonomic practices.
  • Computer Usage: Proficiency with computers, including software applications and communication tools, is essential for tasks and collaboration.
  • Minimal Physical Strain: While physical demands are generally low, occasional light lifting and moving of objects might be required.
  • Structured Schedule: This position usually follows regular business hours, promoting a consistent and predictable work routine.

To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.

EEO Statement

At Accuray, our commitment to patient-first outcomes drives an inclusive and collaborative work environment where the best ideas rise to the top — and everyone works to push them further. We value diversity in both the professional and personal backgrounds of our employees, as this variety adds rich energy to every team, every project and every work day. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin – including individuals with disabilities and veterans.
