Overview

Cotiviti is a leading solutions and analytics company that leverages unparalleled clinical and financial datasets to deliver deep insight into the performance of the healthcare system. These insights uncover new opportunities for healthcare organizations to collaborate to improve their financial performance, reduce inefficiency, and improve healthcare quality.

The Software Engineer is primarily responsible for supporting the performance and stability of critical applications. You will be expected to implement functionality changes and defect fixes that support onboarding of new clients and quick resolution of production issues. Working in a fast-paced environment, where the collective team emphasis is to generate market-driven solutions that work, you are expected to contribute to high performing technical teams: communicating effectively, sharing knowledge, supporting teammates, and building a high-performing team culture while so doing.

You will be required to collaborate effectively with external client team members, senior developers, enterprise technology teams, offshore development team members, business owners, project management, and other internal stakeholders. You will also contribute to designing and augmenting an existing, customized software application to bring transparency, automation, and intelligence for internal Cotiviti systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop high quality, maintainable software modules for the Cotiviti, Inc. software products.
  • Conduct unit and integration testing using appropriate methodology and techniques.
  • Analyze requirements and specifications and create detailed designs for implementation.
  • Change control management. Enter, transcribe, record, store and maintain information in both written and electronic form.
  • Review software engineering approach to proposed solutions to ensure adherence to best practice.
  • Works within the team supporting analytics systems with technology and applications to support our in-house client support partners.
  • Becomes a subject matter expert (SME) for end-to-end Cotiviti client-facing solution for design, development and troubleshooting purposes.
  • Analyzes and resolves software related issues originating from internal or external customers.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues collaboratively within, and across, Cotiviti teams.
  • Documents the specifications, design, features, and operation of applications.
  • Demonstrates proficient working knowledge of the primary discipline and a developing knowledge of related disciplines.
  • Executes, or recommends, solutions enhancements to improve performance / availability.
  • Communicates technical and operational issues to both engineering and business leadership in a clear andtimely manner.
  • Ensure that all technology standards are adhered to while developing systems.
  • Explores new ideas and makes innovative contributions to existing processes or systems which improve efficiency and results.
  • Continuously improves and enhances knowledge of new technologies as selected and integrated into the Cotiviti product suite.
  • Execute all appropriate facets of the Cotiviti Software Development Lifecycle with a desire for continuous improvement and building a high-performing team culture.
  • Mentor, and share knowledge with, other developers and technicians.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • BS or MS Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of industry experience.
  • 3+ years experience with Java.
  • 3+ years experience with databases: Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, and / or PostgreSQL.
  • 3+ years’ experience in SQL development on Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, and / or PostgreSQL.
  • 3+ years’ experience troubleshooting production issues in enterprise Java applications backed by relational databases.
  • Experience with Java frameworks, such as Spring or Spring Boot.
  • Frontend development experience with Angular, React, and / or Vue.
  • Must have 2+ years’ Healthcare data experience.
  • Optimization and tuning of SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers
  • Experience & expertise in resolving issues in production, and client-facing, environments.
  • Proficiency working with large datasets.
  • Ability to analyze requirements and design solutions
  • Experience with Git / Bitbucket and Jenkins a plus; code versioning / repositories a must.
  • Advanced understanding of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design.
  • Strong knowledge and application of SAFe agile practices, preferred.
  • Knowledge of one or more enterprise scheduling tools.

Cognitive/Mental Requirements

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Problem-solving and thinking critically.
  • Completing tasks independently.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
  • Remembering and adhering to processes and protocols.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $91,000 to $118,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Senior Manager, Software Engineer

Location: US Remote


Ready to make a difference?

ICF is seeking a Senior Manager, Software Engineer to lead the engineering team responsible for Sightline ADAPT, a client-facing analytics and decision-support platform serving the utility and energy industries. This individual will directly manage a growing team of software and data engineers while owning the engineering roadmap, guiding major technical decisions, overseeing cloud and production practices, and establishing the standards required to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable products.


The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership with hands-on technical judgment, product thinking, and an AI-first mindset. They will guide Sightline ADAPT’s evolution from analytical workflows and rapidly developed prototypes into maintainable, supportable products while partnering with product and business leaders to align technical investments with user needs, client commitments, and business outcomes.

The Opportunity:

Sightline ADAPT is evolving from project-based analytical capabilities into a reusable platform that integrates customer, building, energy-usage, program, distributed-energy-resource, and grid data to support utility planning and implementation decisions. The team needs a senior software leader with demonstrated experience designing, launching, and scaling enterprise-grade analytical products.

This is not solely a hands-on development position. The successful candidate will establish the engineering practices, delivery model, technical direction, and governance needed to turn working prototypes and analytical methods into maintainable applications and shared platform capabilities.

Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

What you will be doing:

People and Team Leadership

  • Directly manage an initial team of three engineers, with responsibility for performance management, coaching, career development, hiring, onboarding, and future team growth.
  • Set clear expectations, roles, decision rights, and development responsibilities while fostering a collaborative, accountable, and inclusive engineering culture.
  • Plan team capacity, assign work, remove delivery barriers, and help engineers grow their technical and leadership capabilities.
  • Provide engineering leadership across collaborating product, data science, analytics, consulting, infrastructure, security, and client-delivery teams.

Product Strategy and Delivery

  • Partner with product, consulting, and client leaders to understand user needs and translate utility use cases into prioritized product capabilities, technical requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Co-own the product and engineering roadmaps, balancing client commitments, reusable platform capabilities, technical investments, delivery risk, and available team capacity.
  • Lead delivery from discovery through production deployment and ongoing support, developing realistic estimates, staffing plans, implementation approaches, and dependency plans.
  • Identify risks and tradeoffs early, present clear recommendations, and use client feedback, adoption, operational results, and engineering insights to guide priorities and continuous improvement.

Engineering Leadership and Technical Direction

  • Establish standards for coding, testing, documentation, version control, code review, release management, and software quality.
  • Guide major technical decisions and the evolution of applications, APIs, shared services, data products, and client-specific configurations.
  • Ensure that prototypes have a defined path to production rather than becoming unsupported standalone applications.
  • Oversee the cloud, data, deployment, monitoring, and production practices needed to operate Sightline ADAPT securely and reliably in partnership with internal technology and governance teams.

AI-First Engineering and Product Innovation

  • Set an AI-first approach for software development, testing, documentation, operations, analytics, and product capabilities.
  • Help the team adopt AI-assisted engineering workflows while maintaining quality, privacy, security, intellectual-property protection, auditability, and human accountability.
  • Guide the delivery of AI-enabled features, including appropriate evaluation, monitoring, data governance, and human oversight.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies pragmatically and identify where they can improve the product or engineering effectiveness.

Client and Commercial Support

  • Serve as a senior technical authority in selected client meetings, demonstrations, discovery sessions, and solution reviews.
  • Translate client integration, security, data, and operational requirements into practical implementation approaches.
  • Support proposals, scopes of work, estimates, technical narratives, and delivery plans.
  • Communicate capabilities, limitations, dependencies, roadmap decisions, and delivery tradeoffs clearly to technical, client, and executive audiences.
  • Build client confidence in ICF’s ability to deliver and support enterprise-scale analytical applications.

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
  • 5+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including experience leading complex engineering or product initiatives.
  • Prior people management experience directly leading software or data engineers, including coaching, performance management, hiring, and team development.
  • Experience leading data-intensive, client-facing software products from development through production, scaling, and support in cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with Python, SQL, APIs, data engineering, front-end technologies, cloud services, CI/CD, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience setting technical roadmaps, leading cross-functional engineering initiatives, and applying AI-assisted development tools or AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Strong ability to communicate technical decisions, priorities, risks, and tradeoffs to technical, client, and executive audiences.

What we would like you to have:

  • Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Databricks, Apache Spark, Docker.
  • Experience developing data-intensive SaaS platforms, analytical products, or configurable multi-client applications.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, FastAPI, .NET, or comparable modern full-stack application frameworks.
  • Experience operationalizing machine-learning, optimization, digital-twin, generative-AI, or agentic capabilities, including evaluation and monitoring.
  • Experience navigating enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, software-governance, and production-readiness reviews.
  • Experience with utility-sector data and analytical use cases, including customer, AMI, programs, DERs, forecasting, or distribution planning.
  • Familiarity with utility planning and operational technologies such as OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi, DERMS, or ADMS.
  • Experience supporting technical sales, proposals, demonstrations, client discovery, and modernization of analytical codebases or prototypes.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 


Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.


Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 


However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at . We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  


Pay Range

There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.

Description

Channel Factory provides intelligent marketing solutions for the next generation of contextual safety, suitability, and performance for brands and agencies. Our platform helps marketers implement, automate, and scale their marketing programs across the world’s largest video library, YouTube, and emerging growth channels. We sit at the intersection of marketing and suitability and have a mission of enabling the world’s top brands to consciously connect with the right audience in the right context, maximizing suitability and contextual performance.

Channel Factory embodies a strong start-up culture that values diversity, collaboration, and results. Our bias towards execution balances critical thinking, analysis, and pragmatic problem solving. We expect a lot from one another and value our thoughtful and intellectually curious company culture. This position is a full-time role based in the United States. Remote work status is subject to change at any time.

We're looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Media Buyer - Google Platforms to join our team. This role oversees the activation and management of YouTube advertising campaigns. You'll serve as a go-to resource for internal teams on buying best practices, platform policy, and campaign troubleshooting, all while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness. The ideal candidate brings hands-on Google Ads experience, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to operate effectively within a fast-paced team.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of campaign management experience in Google Ads, including Google Ads Editor.
    • Experience with CM360 tracking and troubleshooting.
    • YouTube experience. Specifically, a working knowledge of different YouTube ad formats and their KPIs, including product mixes, Demand Gen, Shorts, and in-stream vs. in-feed ad types.
    • Proficiency in Google Sheets, including pivot tables, formula troubleshooting, and third-party integrations.
    • Comfortable working in a remote-ready tech stack including Slack, Salesforce, and Google Workspace.
    • Willingness to leverage AI tools that improve buying workflows, including setup, QA, bidding, and pacing.
    • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while consistently delivering accurate work and timely communication.
    • Ability to travel for team meetings, training, etc.
  • Bonus points for:
    • Working with conversion-based campaign goals, including online vs. offline conversion measurement, attribution and conversion reporting types, and conversion goal setup in Google Ads.
    • DV360 experience.
    • Bulk editing campaigns via spreadsheet imports and/or SDFs across Google platforms.
    • Familiarity with media deal types and their impact on pacing, including Guaranteed Outcomes, PMPs, and Auction vs. Reservation models.
    • Google Ads certifications.

Benefits

  • Work with a leading startup in a high-demand industry, and you would be working with like-minded experts aiming to transform video ad operations
  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive medical benefits (Medical, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance)
  • Cell phone and Wifi Reimbursement
  • Work-life flexibility – we value your contributions above all

About Channel Factory

Founded in 2010, Channel Factory is an award-winning marketing technology company that helps top global brands and agencies maximize YouTube advertising. Recognized as a technology innovator by Cynopsis and one of the fastest-growing companies by Inc., Channel Factory has served over three hundred of the Fortune 500 in delivering scalable, brand-safe, contextually aligned YouTube advertising software and services. By tapping into the deepest proprietary data pool on the market, the company enables highly customized, contextually aware, and dynamically optimized campaigns and provides industry-leading performance for a portfolio of clients across all industries.

Channel Factory is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Channel Factory makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. The company also has employee resource groups focusing on encouraging inclusion and diversity in the workplace, including an LGBTQ+ committee.

The Business Readiness Deployment Lead ensures hRC user groups and sites are ready to adopt and sustain new processes and capabilities across multi‑wave S/4HANA enterprise deployments. The role provides leadership in readiness strategy, cross‑site/function coordination, process governance, cutover integration, scenario oversight, and executive alignment. This role applies established readiness methodology consistently across waves.

This is a REMOTE role at our Cedar Rapids, IA site.Relocation is not available for this role.

  • Own readiness integrity for assigned user groups across all waves.
  • Approve user-group readiness playbooks and scenario governance.
  • Interpret site-level readiness signals and convert them into recommendations.

2. Strategic & Wave Leadership

  • Translate strategy into actionable multi-wave readiness plans.
  • Identify risks early and coordinate mitigation across sites and functions.
  • Provide executive-level readiness recommendations and drive continuous improvement.

3. Operational & Process Fluency

  • Understand hRC operational realities across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, and aftermarket
  • Ensure consistent adoption of global processes and cross-SBU flows.

  • Ensure consistent adherence to enterprise readiness frameworks, templates, and wave gates.

6.Cutover & Deployment Leadership

  • Support cutover planning, rehearsals, and stabilization across sites

7. Change Leadership & Communication

  • Translate program impacts into clear, role-specific messaging
  • Enable site leaders to prepare their teams and navigate resistance

8. Problem Solving & Adaptability

  • Diagnose issues quickly and adjust plans without losing momentum.
  • Adapt to evolving requirements and operational constraints in a fast-paced environment.
  • Apply pattern recognition to improve readiness consistency wave-to-wave.

9. TRAVEL: Up to 25% travel expected, mostly within the U.S. with some international travel.

  • 7 years in business readiness, transformation leadership, or enterprise deployment
  • Experience leading multi-site or multi-wave readiness efforts.

  • Requires deep management and leadership knowledge to lead cross-department project teams or manage across multiple related departments.

About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking an experienced Sr. Director, AI Powered Service Delivery & Automation to join our team. This remote Brazil –based role reports to the GVP of Global Service Delivery Operations.

Position Summary

The Sr. Director, AI-Powered Service Delivery & Automation is responsible for defining and executing Rimini Street's AI-powered managed services strategy and leading the transformation of AMS from a labor-based support model to an intelligence-driven, automation-enabled service delivery organization. Leveraging AI, agentic workflows, AIOps, observability, and autonomous operations, this leader will design and scale capabilities that improve engineer productivity, automate service delivery activities, accelerate issue resolution, reduce cost-to-serve, and enhance client outcomes across ERP and cloud platforms.

This role is accountable for establishing and achieving measurable automation, AI adoption, productivity, service quality, and service economics targets across the AMS portfolio while driving the adoption of next-generation delivery capabilities globally.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of deploying AI and automation at scale within managed services environments and delivering measurable business outcomes through operational innovation. Success will be measured by increases in automated and AI-assisted resolution rates, reductions in manual engineering effort and cost-to-serve, improvements in service margins, and the establishment of scalable autonomous support capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Lead AI-Powered Service Delivery Transformation

  • Define and execute the roadmap for AI-driven managed services across ERP and cloud platforms.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate diagnosis, triage, resolution, knowledge creation, documentation, and client communications.
  • Establish business cases, governance, and measurable objectives for automated resolution, ticket deflection, engineer productivity, service quality, and margin improvement.
  • Partner across Delivery, Engineering, AI, Product, and Operations teams to drive innovation and adoption.

Build AI-Enabled and Autonomous Service Operations

  • Design and deploy AI-powered assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, and enterprise knowledge capabilities that improve support effectiveness and consistency.
  • Leverage AI, large language models, automation platforms, and knowledge assets to automate support activities and enable autonomous service operations.
  • Establish standards for AI governance, operational controls, performance measurement, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Drive the transition from reactive support to predictive, proactive, and autonomous service delivery.
  • Design and deploy capabilities that increase automated and autonomous case resolution while reducing manual engineering effort.

Drive AIOps and Intelligent Operations

  • Implement AIOps, observability, monitoring, and analytics capabilities to predict, prevent, and remediate service disruptions.
  • Advance self-healing operations through automated remediation, anomaly detection, event correlation, and predictive service management.
  • Partner with ServiceNow and infrastructure teams to mature ITOM, CMDB, service mapping, discovery, and operational intelligence capabilities.

Lead AMS Delivery Transformation

  • Build and lead a global AMS Automation & AI Center of Excellence responsible for AI engineering, intelligent automation, service innovation, and next-generation delivery capabilities.
  • Transform AMS delivery from manual, case-driven execution to AI-assisted and automation-enabled workflows.
  • Standardize scalable delivery patterns, automation frameworks, and operational practices across ERP and cloud service offerings.
  • Drive adoption across global delivery teams and leadership to ensure solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and Delivery leadership to develop AI-enabled service offerings that enhance client value and differentiate Rimini Street in the marketplace.

Improve Productivity and Service Efficiency

  • Deliver capabilities that reduce administrative overhead and improve resolution speed, throughput, first-contact resolution, and engineer productivity.
  • Implement AI-assisted troubleshooting, intelligent routing, knowledge recommendations, automated documentation, and reusable resolution patterns.
  • Establish measurable improvements in cost-to-serve, service quality, and operational performance.

Deliver Scalable Platform Automation

  • Design and implement reusable automation solutions across ERP and cloud platforms, including diagnostics, monitoring, integration management, configuration validation, and release impact assessment.
  • Modernize service management processes by embedding automation, improving workflow efficiency, and enhancing operational visibility and reporting.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and aligned to client, delivery, and business outcomes.

Desired Experience

  • 12+ years leading enterprise managed services, service operations, or technology transformation organizations.
  • Proven track record implementing AI-driven automation, autonomous operations, or digital labor solutions that materially improve service delivery performance and economics.
  • Experience deploying AI platforms, agentic workflows, enterprise knowledge systems, copilots, and intelligent automation capabilities at scale.
  • Strong technical leadership with credibility across architecture, engineering, AI, operations, and executive stakeholder communities.
  • Experience with AIOps, observability, ITOM, predictive operations, automation frameworks, and enterprise service management platforms.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise application support models across ERP and cloud platforms, including SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft technologies.
  • Demonstrated success building new capabilities and leading global transformation programs that improve automation rates, productivity, service quality, customer outcomes, and margin performance.
  • Experience delivering measurable reductions in support effort, ticket volume, or cost-to-serve through AI, automation, or autonomous operations.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, platform, or automation teams within a global managed services organization.

Desired Skills

  • Deep expertise in AI-driven service delivery, agentic automation, autonomous operations, AIOps, observability, and intelligent automation platforms.
  • Strong technical foundation in APIs, integrations, orchestration, automation frameworks, and enterprise service management technologies.
  • Ability to translate technology innovation into measurable business outcomes, including productivity gains, cost reduction, service quality improvements, and margin expansion.
  • Technology-first leadership style with the ability to lead at strategic, architectural, and operational levels.
  • Proven success driving organizational transformation, stakeholder alignment, and adoption across global teams.
  • Exceptional analytical, communication, and influencing skills with experience building and scaling high-performing teams and Centers of Excellence.

Education

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.

Location

Remote – Brazil

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

  • Company
    • We dream big and innovate boldly.
  • Colleagues
    • We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
  • Clients
    • We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.
  • Community
    • We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

  • Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017
  • Over 6,700+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
  • Over 2,000 team members in 23 countries
  • US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here:

Rimini Street is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

To learn more about how Rimini Street is redefining the enterprise software support industry, visit

It’s possible with a role at Linx Printing Technologies ().


Linx, a Veralto company, is a leading global provider of coding and marking solutions for date and batch coding of products and packaging across manufacturing industries. As part of the Linx team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll work with products that make an everyday impact on the food, medicine, and essentials we all rely on—and along the way, you’ll have the chance to make your mark and own your ambition with valuable career growth opportunities.


At Linx, we know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. 


We aspire to lead with empathy, seek firsthand understanding through direct engagement with the work, and make courageous, integrity-driven decisions. These values shape the way we attract, support and retain talent, ensuring that everyone at Linx is empowered to contribute their best and grow in a purpose-led, inclusive and forward-thinking organisation.


Our values are everyone’s responsibility, we live them, lead with them, and bring them to life every day.

Meet Your Manager -


As the Senior Area Sales Manager - South West you will be responsible for driving customer retention and equipment sales growth working closely with your existing customers across a broad range of industries. You could be talking to the CEO of a small batch microbrewery one day and discussing our technology at a dairy farm the next. No two days are the same.


We will provide you with in-depth training to learn our products and industry to enable you to sell a range of Linx coding and marking equipment. This includes industrial small character inkjet, high resolution case printing and Laser solutions. In addition to selling hardware, you will promote a variety of finance and service agreements to our customers. As this territory covers the South West , and is a fully remote role, it would be ideal if you were located near to Bristol, Swindon, or Oxford areas.


In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Business development and expansion of our equipment sales through partnering with our customers.
  • Developing relationships at all levels up to and including the senior leadership.
  • Planning and prioritising your own diary to work on both long term and short term projects
  • Managing sales activity through KPI’s and using our corporate CRM (SalesForce.com).
  • Participate in regional/national trade shows and onsite equipment demonstrations at customers’ sites.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Willingness to travel up to 4 days per week (nights away from home when required)
  • A proven track record in Account Management and evidence of sustained growth
  • Solution selling of capital equipment
  • Ability to take ownership over a broad portfolio of customers
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of a CRM (preferably SFDC) would be advantageous.

It would be preferable if you also had:

  • Experience of solution selling into a manufacturing or production environment
  • An interest in technology
  • A background in electrical or mechanical engineering
  • Experience of coaching or mentoring Junior associates

At Linx, a Veralto Company, we grow talent; we give you the opportunity to develop your career based on your strengths. Linx is a career destination for engaged passionate and talented people who are driven to seek innovation, growth and opportunity.

Linx is proud to be a Product Quality & Innovation company in Veralto (NYSE: VLTO).  Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto is creating today.  Veralto is a $5B global leader in essential technology solutions made up of over 16,000 associates across our Water Quality and Product Identification segments all united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources. 



At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

raw.excerpt: Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments 1.
raw.description:
Group Head of Project Management Office (PMO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Group Head of PMO is responsible for leading and overseeing the Group's project management function across all subsidiaries, business units, and geographical markets within the Insurance & Investments sector.

The role establishes group-wide project governance, portfolio management standards, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems to ensure that strategic projects and transformation initiatives are executed effectively. The position provides centralized oversight of project priorities, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with the Group CEO, executive leadership, subsidiary CEOs, and business heads, the Group Head of PMO ensures that all major projects support the organization's strategic growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and long-term business objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

Group PMO Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Group's overall Project Management Office strategy, structure, and operating framework.
  • Establish standardized project management methodologies, governance policies, procedures, and reporting requirements across all subsidiaries.
  • Define project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Ensure project portfolios are aligned with the Group's strategic objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish consistent project management standards and controls across geographical markets and business units.

Strategic Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the consolidated project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate, and operational business units.
  • Evaluate, prioritize, and monitor strategic projects based on business value, financial impact, risk exposure, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions or changes in resource allocation.
  • Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of project portfolio performance.

Insurance & Investment Project Oversight

  • Oversee group-wide projects involving insurance product development, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution expansion.
  • Monitor investment-related projects involving portfolio reporting, investment operations, wealth management platforms, and client servicing, where applicable.
  • Coordinate strategic initiatives involving regulatory compliance, business process modernization, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the implementation of new financial products, business models, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Ensure projects meet relevant insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Provide governance and oversight for group-wide technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate implementation of enterprise systems, CRM platforms, automation solutions, AI applications, and digital financial services.
  • Work with CIO, CTO, CDO, and business leadership to ensure successful technology project delivery.
  • Monitor system integration, implementation risks, technology budgets, and business adoption.
  • Ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer experience and operational performance.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee consolidated project budgets, financial forecasts, and expenditure tracking across the Group.
  • Monitor project cost performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Coordinate resource allocation across subsidiaries, departments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Evaluate project business cases, cost-benefit analysis, ROI, and expected benefits.
  • Ensure effective utilization of internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and implementation partners.

Risk, Compliance & Quality Management

  • Establish group-level project risk management and escalation frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, financial, regulatory, technology, and implementation risks across project portfolios.
  • Coordinate with group risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit functions.
  • Ensure projects comply with internal policies, governance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establish contingency and mitigation plans for critical projects and strategic programs.

Performance Reporting & Benefits Realization

  • Develop group-wide project dashboards, performance reports, and executive presentations.
  • Monitor project delivery against approved scope, budgets, timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
  • Track financial benefits, operational improvements, and ROI from strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare regular portfolio performance reports for the Group CEO, Board, and executive committees.
  • Recommend strategic interventions to improve project execution and delivery performance.

Stakeholder & Subsidiary Management

  • Work closely with subsidiary CEOs, managing directors, business unit heads, project sponsors, and program directors.
  • Facilitate group-level project steering committees and portfolio review meetings.
  • Coordinate project planning and delivery across subsidiaries and corporate functions.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology vendors, contractors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure consistent communication, accountability, and reporting across all Group entities.

Leadership & PMO Capability Development

  • Lead and develop the Group PMO team, including PMO directors, project managers, project analysts, and project controls specialists.
  • Establish PMO structures, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across subsidiaries.
  • Develop project management training, mentoring, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management maturity across the organization.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Project Management, Business Strategy, Finance, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, portfolio management, or enterprise transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior PMO leadership position overseeing multiple business units, subsidiaries, or large project portfolios.
  • Experience in insurance, reinsurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or diversified financial services.
  • Proven track record of establishing or leading enterprise-level or group-level PMO functions.
  • Strong knowledge of project portfolio governance, financial management, resource planning, risk management, and strategic execution.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-country or multi-entity projects and transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Certifications:

- Project Management Professional (PMP).

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP).
  • Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP).

- PRINCE2 Practitioner.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of group-wide projects delivered on time and within approved budgets.
  • Overall project portfolio performance against Group strategic objectives.
  • Project cost variance and schedule variance.
  • Group PMO governance and reporting compliance.
  • Successful delivery of strategic insurance and investment initiatives.
  • Project risk identification, mitigation, and escalation effectiveness.
  • Resource utilization and allocation efficiency across subsidiaries.
  • Benefits realization and ROI of major strategic projects.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of consolidated project reporting.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction across Group entities.
  • Improvement in project management maturity across subsidiaries.
  • Reduction in project delays, cost overruns, and implementation risks.

raw.description:
We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support multiple Agile implementation teams—referred to as pods—within the Arc technology platform.
The ideal candidate will facilitate Scrum practices, improve sprint execution, remove delivery impediments, and promote transparency across the pods. This role requires close collaboration with Product Owners, technical leads, Technical Project Managers, and delivery leadership.
The candidate will help teams improve their Agile maturity, maintain consistent delivery practices, and strengthen collaboration across teams. We are looking for a self-driven, proactive, and responsive professional who can take initiative, anticipate delivery challenges, communicate effectively, and work collaboratively with distributed teams.

Please submit your resume in English.

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery and Facilitation

  • Serve as Scrum Master for multiple software development pods, guiding teams in Scrum practices and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring meetings are productive, timeboxed, and outcome-focused.
  • Lead the refinement and planning process while ensuring Product Owners retain responsibility for backlog maintenance and prioritization, and teams retain ownership of their commitments.
  • Track sprint health and delivery metrics, including velocity, commitment versus completion, and carryover, working with technical leads to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date JIRA boards to ensure transparency of work, capacity, progress, and delivery status.
  • Proactively identify potential delivery challenges, dependencies, and risks, taking initiative to address them before they impact sprint commitments.

Risk and Stakeholder Management

  • Identify, track, communicate, and help resolve pod-level risks, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Escalate cross-pod risks and delivery concerns to the appropriate Technical Project Manager.
  • Provide timely daily, weekly, and sprint-level delivery updates to Product Owners, Technical Project Managers, technology leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Assist Product Owners with the triage of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) issues, production support tickets, and software defects.
  • Facilitate effective communication between stakeholders and development teams.
  • Ensure follow-ups and action items are tracked through completion, maintaining responsiveness and accountability.
  • Prepare and present sprint status, delivery metrics, risks, and key updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Team Coaching and Continuous Improvement

  • Coach teams toward self-management, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration to focus on outcome results.
  • Foster a collaborative environment that encourages transparency, open communication, and continuous learning.
  • Help resolve team conflicts and remove barriers to effective collaboration.
  • Identify process improvements through retrospectives and track agreed actions through completion.
  • Support the adoption of approved AI tools that improve Agile practices, in accordance with organizational data policies.
  • Collaborate with other Scrum Masters to share best practices and promote consistency across teams.
  • Take initiative, and encourage others, to identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, communication, and delivery processes without waiting for direction.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
  • Experience supporting multiple Agile teams simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve sprint execution and help teams deliver consistently.
  • Strong working knowledge of Scrum principles, roles, events, and artifacts.
  • Experience coaching teams toward self-management and continuous improvement.
  • Experience tracking, analyzing, and communicating sprint metrics.
  • Proficiency with JIRA, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
  • Familiarity with web technologies and the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong facilitation skills and the ability to keep meetings focused and productive.
  • Ability to resolve conflicts, build consensus, and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to identify and remove blockers and determine when escalation is necessary.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of responsibilities and independently drive activities to completion.
  • Responsive and dependable, with a strong sense of urgency in addressing team needs, stakeholder requests, and delivery issues.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong presentation skills, including the ability to prepare and present sprint updates, delivery metrics, risks, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Scrum certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PSM – AI Essentials, or SAFe Scrum Master.
  • Familiarity with Kanban and scaled Agile practices, such as Scrum of Scrums.
  • Familiarity with Evidence-Based Management (EBM) or other outcome-focused approaches to measuring team performance.
  • Experience using AI tools to support Agile teams, including meeting summaries, backlog refinement, or sprint analytics.
  • Experience supporting UAT and production support triage.
  • Experience working with mission-driven or nonprofit organizations.
Please list any relevant certifications in your application.

Education

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

raw.description:
AlphaGov delivers public-sector consulting for cities, counties, school systems, special districts, utilities, and related agencies. Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.

We engage experienced practitioners as project-based collaborators. Engagements are remote-first with occasional client travel. When you authorize it, AlphaGov may name you as an expert collaborator or key personnel on proposals that match your expertise. We build ready teams for live pursuits - not speculative staffing banks.

AlphaGov is building a bench of executive recruiters who lead superintendent searches for K-12 school districts and boards of education. You would guide boards through a transparent, community-informed search, from the leadership profile through final selection and transition.

We confirm scope, schedule, and fee with you before any engagement begins.

What you'll do

  • Facilitate board planning sessions and set the search process and timeline
  • Run stakeholder engagement, including staff, parent, student, and community surveys, forums, and focus groups, to build the leadership profile
  • Write the position profile and advertise through education networks and associations
  • Source, recruit, and screen candidates, including diverse and nontraditional candidates
  • Conduct reference, background, credential, and media checks
  • Prepare interview questions and support board interviews, finalist visits, and deliberations
  • Support contract negotiation and transition planning for the new superintendent
  • Contribute qualifications and past-performance narrative to AlphaGov proposals when you authorize naming

Apply to be considered.

Requirements

Required

  • At least 5 years leading or co-leading superintendent or senior K-12 executive searches for school boards
  • A record of completed placements, with references from board chairs or district leaders
  • Experience running community engagement for a public search
  • Comfortable as a 1099 project-based consultant

Nice to have

  • Former superintendent, assistant superintendent, or school board member
  • Experience with open-meetings and public-records rules that apply to board searches
  • College president or city manager search experience

About the assignment

We are looking for an experienced OCI Network Specialist with strong expertise in designing, implementing and managing complex network infrastructures on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. The role is focused on architecting scalable, secure hybrid cloud network solutions, optimizing performance and providing advanced operational support. You will collaborate with cloud architects, security and DevOps teams to deliver end-to-end networking solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Network Architecture & Design:
  • Architect, design, and implement scalable and highly available network topologies on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Design Virtual Cloud Networks (VCN), subnets, gateways, route tables, security lists, and Network Security Groups (NSGs) as per best practices.
  • Plan and implement Hub-and-Spoke and other advanced network architectures for multi-region and multi-tenancy OCI environments.
  • Design and manage OCI Load Balancers (Public and Private) including Layer 4 and Layer 7 configurations.
  • Architect solutions for OCI Network Firewall, WAF, and DDoS protection.
  • Hybrid Connectivity:
  • Design and implement hybrid connectivity solutions using OCI FastConnect and Site-to-Site VPN (IPSec).
  • Manage BGP routing configurations for FastConnect and peering setups.
  • Configure and maintain OCI Dynamic Routing Gateways (DRG) for inter-VCN and on-premises connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize WAN, MPLS, and SD-WAN integrations with OCI.
  • Network Security & Governance:
  • Implement and manage network security policies using Security Lists, NSGs, OCI Network Firewall, and WAF.
  • Conduct network security assessments and ensure compliance with industry standards (CIS, NIST, ISO 27001).
  • Monitor network traffic and analyze flow logs using OCI VCN Flow Logs and third-party SIEM tools.
  • Implement Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles on OCI.
  • Performance & Optimization:
  • Monitor network performance metrics and resolve bottlenecks proactively.
  • Optimize OCI network configurations for latency, throughput, and cost.
  • Conduct capacity planning for network bandwidth and connectivity.
  • Leverage OCI Network Path Analyzer and Network Visualizer for diagnostics.
  • Operations & Support:
  • Provide Level 3 support for network incidents and escalations.
  • Develop and maintain network runbooks, SOPs, and architecture documentation.
  • Participate in change management and release planning for network changes.
  • Coordinate with Oracle support for network-related service requests and critical issue resolution.
  • Perform regular network audits and vulnerability assessments.
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:
  • Work closely with cloud architects, security engineers, and application teams to ensure network requirements are met.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior network engineers.
  • Engage with clients and stakeholders to gather requirements and present network design proposals.
  • Participate in pre-sales activities and proof-of-concept (PoC) engagements.

Requirements

Mandatory

  • We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced OCI Network Specialist with 7 to 11 years of expertise in designing, implementing, and managing complex network infrastructures on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Strong expertise in OCI VCN, Subnets, Route Tables, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, Service Gateway, Local Peering Gateway (LPG), Remote Peering Connection (RPC).
  • Hands-on experience with OCI Dynamic Routing Gateway (DRG v2).
  • Proficiency in OCI FastConnect, IPSec VPN, and BGP routing.
  • Experience with OCI Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, and Application Load Balancer.
  • Expertise in OCI Network Firewall and Web Application Firewall (WAF).
  • Knowledge of OCI DNS (Private and Public), Traffic Management, and Email Delivery services.
  • Experience with OCI Network Path Analyzer, Network Visualizer, and VCN Flow Logs.
  • Deep understanding of TCP/IP, OSI model, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIP), switching, and VLAN configurations.
  • Strong knowledge of network security concepts including firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, NAT, ACLs, and Zero Trust.
  • Experience with IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, subnetting, and CIDR.
  • Proficiency in network monitoring tools (Wireshark, tcpdump, Nagios, Zabbix, or equivalent).
  • Experience in hybrid cloud network design and implementation.
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN, MPLS, and WAN optimization technologies.
  • Familiarity with multi-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, OCI interconnects).
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform for OCI network provisioning.
  • Familiarity with OCI CLI and OCI SDKs for network automation.
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for network tasks.
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Certified Networking Professional (OCI Networking Professional)
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Foundations Associate (OCI Foundations Associate)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with CDN services and OCI Edge Services.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes networking (OKE - Oracle Kubernetes Engine).
  • Knowledge of OCI Observability and Monitoring services.
  • Understanding of OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM) as it relates to network resource governance.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management frameworks.
  • Experience with network compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2).
  • Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows server networking.
  • Exposure to cloud cost optimization strategies for networking workloads.
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and API Gateway networking.
  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) network configurations.
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Architect Associate / OCI Architect Professional
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) - Enterprise or Security
  • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) - Enterprise Infrastructure or Security (Highly Desirable)
  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty (Good to Have)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (Good to Have)
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) (Good to Have)
  • CompTIA Network+ or CompTIA Security+

raw.description:
NeoWork is a global outsourcing partner that connects businesses with dedicated remote professionals. We believe in building long-term careers for our team members while delivering exceptional, human-centered service for our clients. This role sits at the heart of that mission supporting a fast-growing homecare client where compassion, calm, and quick thinking matter most.

Role Overview

As an Staffing Coordinator, you will serve as the primary point of contact for a US-based homecare agency during overnight hours US hours. You will handle inbound calls from caregivers and clients, troubleshoot real-time issues, coordinate caregiver scheduling, and document each interaction clearly for the daytime team.

This is a high-empathy, high-stakes support role. Callers may be stressed, scared, or frustrated — your ability to stay calm, listen actively, and take swift action makes a real difference in people's lives.

Key Responsibilities

• Answer and manage inbound calls from caregivers and clients during overnight hours, providing responsive and professional support.

• De-escalate emotionally charged situations with empathy and composure, ensuring callers feel heard and supported.

• Problem-solve in real time — assess each situation, identify the right course of action, and follow through.

• Coordinate caregiver staffing to fill open or vacated shifts, matching availability with client needs efficiently.

• Maintain thorough, clear written logs of every call and action taken, giving the daytime team full context to continue seamlessly.

• Escalate complex or urgent situations appropriately, following established protocols.

• Build familiarity with client care plans, caregiver profiles, and agency workflows over time.

Requirements

• Confident, professional communicator over the phone clear, calm, and easy to understand.

• Demonstrated ability to de-escalate tense situations and lead interactions with empathy and patience.

• Strong written English, able to write accurate, concise call summaries and shift notes.

• Comfortable working autonomously during overnight hours with minimal supervision.

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, distraction-free work environment.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in homecare, caregiving, or a related healthcare support environment — especially in California.

• Familiarity with home care agency operations, caregiver scheduling, or care coordination.

• Background in customer service, a call center, or dispatch-style support roles.

Experience handling urgent or sensitive calls (e.g., medical, social services, crisis support).

Benefits

  • We offer health insurance
  • Holiday Extra Pay
  • This is a 100% home-based position
  • We prioritize the mental health of our team members and offer mental health days to support their well-being.
  • There is an annual review and appraisal process in place.

Position Description

  • Position Title: HR Administrator – Teneo (Voluntary Administration)
  • Reports To: HR Director (direct reporting line)
  • HR Advisor (day to day functional guidance)
  • Location: Offshore (remote) — Philippines
  • Working Hours: 9.00am to 5.00pm Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST), Monday to Friday

This role follows the Australian business calendar and includes working on Philippines public holidays.


﻿Employment Type: Full time

Position Purpose

The HR Administrator provides administrative and record keeping support to the Human Resources function of The Infinity Group, working under the direct line management of the HR Director and the day to day functional guidance of the HR Advisor. This role is dedicated solely to stores administered by the Teneo Administrators, and is primarily responsible for HR record keeping, correspondence support, and assistance with the preparation and tracking of employment contracts for stores within its remit.

The role is administrative in nature and does not carry responsibility for performance management, disciplinary matters, investigations or terminations. All performance related matters must be escalated to the HR Advisor and/or HR Director immediately and are not to be handled or responded to by the HR Administrator, unless the response is administrative only i.e., lunch break hours confirmation, etc.

Key Responsibilities

HR Inbox and Query Support

  • Assist the HR Advisor in monitoring and managing the HR inbox on a daily basis for Teneo administered stores, ensuring queries are acknowledged and actioned within agreed timeframes.
  • Respond to routine, administrative HR queries from employees and store managers within Teneo administered stores in a professional, clear and accurate manner.
  • Identify and immediately escalate all performance related, disciplinary, investigation or termination related queries to the HR Advisor and/or HR Director. No response is to be provided on these matters by the HR Administrator.
  • Maintain accurate records of correspondence and queries in accordance with company record keeping requirements.

﻿Records, Contract and Document Administration

  • Prepare and populate new employment contracts and contract variations for Teneo administered stores in accordance with approved templates and instructions, for checking by the HR Advisor prior to submission for approval.
  • Maintain and update contract trackers, workbooks and personnel records relevant to Teneo administered stores, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Support the tracking of contract and correspondence approval status with the Teneo Administrators, and follow up outstanding items in a timely manner under the direction of the HR Advisor.
  • Maintain accurate offboarding and personnel data in Employment Hero and ClockOn as directed.

General Administrative Support

  • Provide day to day administrative support to the HR Director, HR Advisor and broader HR team.
  • Assist with the preparation, formatting and distribution of HR correspondence and documentation as directed.
  • Maintain confidentiality of all employee and company information at all times.
  • Undertake other administrative duties as reasonably required by the HR Director or HR Advisor.

Key Selection Criteria

Essential

  • Strong administrative and organisational skills with high attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Microsoft Teams and Excel.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Availability to work 9.00am to 5.00pm Australian Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday, in line with the Australian business calendar, including on Philippines public holidays.
  • A strong understanding of confidentiality requirements when handling employee information.

Desirable

  • Working knowledge of the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth), the National Employment Standards and the Pharmacy Industry Award.
  • General understanding of Australian human resources and industrial relations principles.
  • Familiarity with Employment Hero (Desired but not essential)
  • Familiarity with ClockOn (Desired but not essential)

Key Relationships

  • HR Director (direct report line and escalation point for all performance related matters).
  • HR Advisor (day to day functional guidance and task allocation).
  • Internal HR and payroll team members.
  • Store managers and store level personnel within Teneo administered stores.
  • Administrators (Teneo), for contract and correspondence approval purposes.

Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Role summary:

The Senior Manager, Marketing Technology will lead the strategy and evolution of Walmart Marketplace Seller Marketing’s technology ecosystem, enabling personalized, scalable, and measurable seller experiences. Reporting into Marketing Enablement & Intelligence (ME&I), this leader will own the MarTech capability roadmap and partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions. The role will drive platform governance, integration, automation, and technology investments while advancing intelligent, data-driven, per-seller decisioning across channels and markets.
About the team:
The Marketing Enablement & Intelligence (ME&I) team supports Walmart Marketplace Seller Marketing by integrating marketing operations, technology, analytics, and localization. This team develops systems and processes that enable data-driven decision-making, streamlined execution, and measurable business outcomes. Collaborating across functions, ME&I enhances efficiency and scalability in marketing efforts. The team focuses on strategic planning, marketing technology solutions, and automation to drive growth and optimize performance. Members contribute to building capabilities that align with business goals, ensuring effective marketing strategies and execution that support Walmart’s overall objectives.
What you'll do:
  • Own the Seller Marketing MarTech strategy, roadmap, architecture, and technology investments.
  • Lead the evolution and integration of CRM, automation, personalization, content management, and digital platforms.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate business needs into scalable technology capabilities.
  • Advance AI-enabled personalization, journey orchestration, and intelligent per-seller decisioning.
  • Establish platform governance, standards, and adoption practices while simplifying workflows and improving operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Analytics to strengthen data integration, measurement, and marketing effectiveness.
  • Lead technology evaluation, vendor management, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Build MarTech capabilities and influence cross-functional technology priorities.

What you'll bring:
  • Extensive experience in marketing technology, CRM, automation, digital platforms, or product management.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute enterprise-scale MarTech strategies and roadmaps.
  • Strong knowledge of CRM/CDP, personalization, journey orchestration, content management, analytics, and data integrations.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams.
  • Understanding of customer data, segmentation, consent, activation, and measurement.
  • Experience evaluating vendors, technology investments, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Strong strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to lead complex initiatives from strategy through implementation.
