raw.excerpt: ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:• Lead the definition and evolution of the enterprise data platform strategy by developing, maintaining, and continuously evolving architecture standards, reference architectures, and design patterns aligned with business priorities, analytical requirements, and AI/ML enablement across data and ETL/ELT platforms.
raw.description:
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead the definition and evolution of the enterprise data platform strategy by developing, maintaining, and continuously evolving architecture standards, reference architectures, and design patterns aligned with business priorities, analytical requirements, and AI/ML enablement across data and ETL/ELT platforms.
  • Develop, maintain, and steward enterprise architecture artifacts and documentation—including current and target state designs, diagrams, standards, and decision records—ensuring accuracy, consistency, and accessibility within the architecture repository.
  • Evaluate, recommend, and govern the selection of data platforms and ETL/ELT tools, balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational maturity while reducing unnecessary platform sprawl.
  • Review and guide data platform and pipeline designs to ensure consistency with enterprise standards, scalability requirements, and architectural best practices.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to data engineering teams, analytics teams, platform product owners to translate architecture standards into implementable solutions and influence technical direction across the organization.
  • Define architectural guardrails that ensure data platforms can scale reliably, meet performance expectations, and support high availability and disaster recovery requirements.
  • Establish architectural standards for platform operations, environment management, reliability, observability, deployment automation, and lifecycle management to ensure data platforms are production-ready and supportable.
  • Ensure data platform architectures incorporate security controls, data privacy requirements, and regulatory compliance (e.g., access controls, encryption, data lineage, and retention) by default.
  • Define and standardize ETL/ELT and data integration patterns, including batch, streaming, and event driven approaches, to support analytics, operational reporting, and downstream consumption.
  • Participate in enterprise architecture governance forums, providing clear architectural guidance and decision support for data platform and integration initiatives.
  • Incorporate financial discipline into platform architecture by guiding cost efficient design, platform right sizing, and lifecycle management in partnership with FinOps and platform teams.
  • Continuously assess emerging data platform and ETL technologies, recommending updates to standards and strategy as capabilities and business needs evolve.
  • Drive innovation in AI-powered data engineering workflows and automation.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 7+ years in database engineering with 3+ years in database architecture design and support.

Preferred Education, Additional Qualifications and Experience

  • Master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Systems Engineering, or Computer Science
  • Familiarity with healthcare payer data domains such as claims, eligibility, provider, member, care management, utilization management, or regulatory reporting.
  • Experience designing API‑based data integration using Apigee
  • Integration with enterprise systems including Salesforce, FACETS, and ServiceNow

Required Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities

  • Experience architecting enterprise data platforms across cloud environments (Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Deep knowledge of Snowflake as an enterprise data warehouse platform.
  • Hands-on familiarity with modern data platforms and services (e.g. Azure Data Lake/ADLS, Fabric, Databricks, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle).
  • Hands‑on experience with ETL/ELT orchestration platforms (Matillion).
  • Strong hands‑on technical fluency with SQL and Python sufficient to prototype, review optimize, and guide engineering implementation of data pipelines and transformations.
  • Ability to design analytics‑ready datasets that support reporting, operational analytics, and AI/ML use cases.
  • Experience with data architecture patterns, including layered architectures (ingestion, transformation, repository, consumption).
  • Experience with data modeling, analytics platforms, and data governance concepts.
  • Ability to design data platforms with security controls by default, including access controls, encryption, data lineage, and retention.
  • Experience integrating internal and external data sources using secure, governed ingestion methods.
  • Ability to translate architectural standards into implementable solutions with engineering teams.
  • Experience enabling AI/ML workloads through scalable, well‑governed data platforms.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure‑as‑code concepts, automation, and CI/CD for data platforms.
  • Understanding of observability, reliability, and operational readiness for data pipelines and platforms.
  • Ability to evaluate emerging data technologies and recommend adoption based on maturity, risk, and business value.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts to engineering with good diagramming hygiene for mutual understanding.
  • Proficient communication and presentation skills for inter-level audiences.
  • Comfortable in agile or waterfall methodologies.

raw.description:
About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

Job Description:

The Benefits Coordination and Recovery of Call Center Customer Service Representative (CSR) supports Medicare beneficiaries, authorized representatives, employers, insurers, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders with questions related to other health insurance coverage and Medicare’s payment responsibility.

The CSR reviews and updates beneficiary insurance information, helps determine the appropriate order of payment, and explains Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) requirements. This role requires accurate documentation, strong customer service skills, and strict compliance with Centers for Medicare (CMS), HIPAA, privacy, security, and program requirements.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Handle inbound calls concerning Medicare Coordination of Benefits and Medicare Secondary Payer matters.
  • Assist beneficiaries, authorized representatives, employers, insurers, providers, attorneys, and other approved callers.
  • Collect, verify, research, and update other health insurance information, including Employer group health plan coverage and non-group health plan coverage.
  • Apply approved Medicare Secondary Payer rules and procedures to determine whether Medicare may pay primary or secondary.
  • Accurately enter and update insurance records, call details, and supporting information.
  • Protect personally identifiable information and protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and applicable privacy and security requirements.
  • Meet established standards for quality, attendance, and schedule adherence.
  • Complete required training and remain current on Medicare COB and MSP program updates.

  • High School Graduate or equivalent required.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

EXPERIENCE


  • Six months in a call center, customer service, healthcare, health insurance or related environment.
  • Must be able to type 20 WPM, 30 WPM preferred.
  • Ability to explain insurance and Medicare information in clear, easy-to-understand language.
  • Demonstrated empathy, professionalism, active listening, and de-escalation skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry abilities.
  • Ability to navigate several applications while speaking with callers and documenting interactions.
  • Ability to work independently and protect sensitive information in a remote setting in Oklahoma City, OK.

REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS


  • Maintain a private, quiet, and secure workspace free from unauthorized individuals and interruptions.
  • Maintain reliable high-speed internet that meets technical requirements.
  • Use employer-provided equipment, authentication tools, and communication systems as directed.

  • Be available for assigned shifts, which may include evenings or overtime based on program needs.
  • Must reside in Oklahoma City, OK.

raw.description:
Votre rôle

En tant que Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultants. Vous piloterez opérationnellement les missions, participerez activement au développement commercial, au marketing de l’offre et au développement de l’expertise au sein du cabinet.

Vous intervenez comme directeur de projet auprès de directions immobilières, directions des environnements de travail et directions des systèmes d’information dans la définition de leur stratégie Smart Building et dans la transformation numérique de leurs bâtiments, depuis l’expression des besoins jusqu’au déploiement des solutions et à leur adoption par les utilisateurs.

Vos principales responsabilités

1.Développement commercial et management

  • Encadrer, accompagner et faire progresser des consultants.
  • Réalisation des rendez-vous d’avant-vente et aux phases de qualification.
  • Pilotage de la rédaction des propositions commerciales et des réponses aux appels d’offres.
  • Structurer les démarches, charges, livrables et dispositifs d’intervention.
  • Présenter les propositions aux clients et défendre les choix méthodologiques.
  • Développer des offres, méthodes, référentiels et convictions autour du Smart Building.
  • Participer à la veille technologique, réglementaire et concurrentielle.

2.Pilotage de mission de conseil et cadrage stratégique

  • Analyser les enjeux usagers, immobiliers, énergétiques, environnementaux, numériques et organisationnels des clients.
  • Construire une vision cible du bâtiment intelligent adaptée à leurs priorités et à leur patrimoine.
  • Réaliser des diagnostics de maturité Smart Building et Digital Workplace.
  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage à valeur :
    • performance énergétique ;
    • optimisation de l’occupation et des espaces ;
    • confort et qualité des environnements intérieurs ;
    • maintenance prédictive ;
    • expérience collaborateur ;
    • services aux occupants ;
    • sûreté et sécurité ;
    • pilotage multisite du patrimoine.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route, scénarios de transformation et modèles de gouvernance.
  • Contribuer à la construction des trajectoires d'ambition digitales.

3.Pilotage de conception fonctionnelle et architecture Smart Building

  • Recueillir les besoins des directions métiers, immobilières, techniques et informatiques.
  • Formaliser les cas d’usage, parcours utilisateurs et exigences fonctionnelles.
  • Participer à la définition des architectures fonctionnelles et applicatives.
  • Définir les principes d’articulation entre :
    • équipements et systèmes du bâtiment ;
    • GTB/GTC ;
    • IoT et capteurs ;
    • réseaux et connectivité ;
    • Building Operating System ou plateforme de services ;
    • BIM et BIM GEM ;
    • systèmes d’information immobiliers ;
    • outils Workplace ;
    • plateformes de données ;
    • applications destinées aux occupants.

4.Pilotage de prestation d’assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage et pilotage de projets

  • Accompagner les clients dans la rédaction de programmes fonctionnels et de cahiers des charges.
  • Participer à la consultation et à la sélection de fournisseurs, intégrateurs et éditeurs.
  • Analyser les réponses techniques et fonctionnelles.
  • Assurer la coordination entre les différents acteurs du projet :
  • Piloter les risques, dépendances, arbitrages et plans d’action.
  • Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance.
  • Suivre la réalisation des pilotes, démonstrateurs et déploiements.
  • Préparer les phases de recette fonctionnelle et de mise en service.
  • Vérifier l’alignement des solutions déployées avec les usages et la vision initiale.

5. Pilotage de mission de conduite du changement

  • Comprendre les attentes des occupants, exploitants et gestionnaires.
  • Concevoir des parcours de services simples et cohérents.
  • Animer des ateliers de design de services ou de co-construction.
  • Participer à la définition des modalités d’adoption des nouveaux services numériques.
  • Accompagner les équipes clientes dans l’évolution de leurs pratiques.
  • Mesurer l’usage, la satisfaction et la valeur créée après le déploiement.

Votre profil

Formation et expériences

  • Formation supérieure Bac+5, école d’ingénieurs, école de commerce, université ou formation spécialisée en immobilier, bâtiment, numérique ou systèmes d’information.
  • Expérience professionnelle de 8 ans minimum, acquise dans le conseil, l’immobilier, l’ingénierie, l’intégration de solutions ou la transformation digitale.
  • Expérience significative sur des projets Smart Building, Smart Workplace, immobilier numérique, IoT, performance énergétique ou exploitation technique.
  • Expérience de pilotage de missions, de lots ou de projets complexes impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.
  • Une expérience en management en cabinet de conseil constitue un atout important.

Vos qualités

  • Forte capacité d’analyse et de synthèse.
  • Aptitude à comprendre et à articuler des enjeux métiers, immobiliers et technologiques.
  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et relationnelles.
  • Capacité à animer des ateliers et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction.
  • Pédagogie et capacité à rendre accessibles des sujets techniques complexes.
  • Autonomie dans la conduite des missions.
  • Esprit de conseil et orientation client.
  • Goût du travail collectif et des environnements pluridisciplinaires.
  • Capacité à structurer et sécuriser des projets complexes.
  • Curiosité pour les innovations, les usages et les évolutions du marché.
  • Capacité à encadrer et faire progresser des consultants

Entité

L'ambition d'Orange Business est de devenir l'intégrateur réseaux et numérique de référence en Europe, en nous appuyant sur nos forces autour des solutions de connectivité nouvelle génération, du cloud et de la cybersécurité.

Nos 30 000 femmes et hommes présents dans 65 pays, dont chaque voix compte, sont tous animés par la même détermination et le même esprit d'équipe, pour construire les solutions digitales d'aujourd'hui et de demain et créer un impact positif pour nos clients, pour leurs salariés et pour la planète.

Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes grâce à des projets innovants dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, l'IoT, ou encore le digital workspace et le big data.

Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous !

Travailler chez Orange Consulting, c'est rejoindre un cabinet à taille humaine qui offre à ses collaborateurs des perspectives d'évolution claires et accessibles à travers des parcours de formations spécialement conçus par et pour nos consultants.

La direction Orange Consulting accompagne les entreprises et les institutions en France et à l'international sur leurs problématiques de transformation digitale et leurs enjeux métiers.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Power BI & Power Platform Developer to join our team, supporting the design, deployment, and maintenance of solutions in highly secure environments, particularly within government agencies and defense contractors.

The successful candidate will have a strong background in requirements gathering, creating data visualizations and engineering enterprise solutions, Candidate will deploy custom dynamic visualizations (such as organizational charts) in Power BI to serve customer needs and collaborating closely with the engineering team to support the broader Power Platform ecosystem, serving as a versatile resource to help coordinate platform capabilities, facilitate technical alignments, and support enterprise-wide initiatives.

This role is 100% remote. Travel may be required in order to obtain government furnished equipment. In additional this role may require occasional travel based on customer requirements (less than 10%).


MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

  • Gather and analyze business requirements from stakeholders to understand their needs and objectives.

  • Conduct thorough data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights to support decision-making processes.

  • Develop detailed business process models, workflows, and diagrams to visualize current and future state processes.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.

  • Assist in the design, development, and implementation of new systems, processes, and tools.

  • Create and maintain documentation such as business requirements documents, user stories, and test cases.

  • Facilitate meetings and workshops with stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve issues, and communicate project status.

  • Provide ongoing support and training to end-users on implemented solutions.

  • Review and analyze system specifications to understand testing requirements.

  • Develop test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project documentation.

  • Execute test cases and report defects, ensuring thorough coverage of software functionality.

  • Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to resolve issues and improve product quality.

  • Conduct functional, regression, and performance testing as necessary.

  • Participate in meetings and discussions to provide input on project status and quality concerns.

  • Document testing processes, results, and findings for future reference.

  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify industry trends and opportunities.

  • Assist in the preparation of business cases, feasibility studies, and project plans.

  • Participate in quality assurance activities such as user acceptance testing and system validation.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED (Required):

  • Bachelor’s Degree.

  • Minimum of an active Secret security clearance.

  • Current CompTIA Sec+ CE, CompTIA SecurityX, or CISSP certification.

  • 8+ years of experience in Power BI & Power Platform.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI development.

  • Proficiency with business intelligence and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

  • Proficiency in business analysis tools and techniques such as process mapping, data modeling, and requirements elicitation.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage the technical systems engineering life cycle(s) including requirements analysis, configuration, design, development, testing and deployment of systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot high-level technical and non-technical issues. Experience in evaluating, testing, deploying and maintaining both custom developed and third-party software upgrades.

  • Demonstrated ability in creating and maintaining system architecture and troubleshooting documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to prepare plans and assessments, such as management engineering plans, integrated support plans, and implementation plans. Develops integrated system requirements and proposed design solutions.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities.

  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals.

  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off.

  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace.

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY:

  • Explore a career in program management at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your passion for the mission and delivering results.

The likely salary range for this position is $85,093 - $115,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Travel Required:

Less than 10%

Telecommuting Options:

Remote

Work Location:

Any Location / Remote

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development.Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events at

Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Long Term Incentive Plan: Cash payment for Executive level roles only, representing a cash payment which is both time and performance based.

Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
